raw.description:
Description

The Director, Vendor Management is responsible for the strategic leadership and operational oversight of Indero’s Vendor Management Office (VMO) and enterprise vendor governance program. The Director establishes and maintains the vendor governance framework and oversees vendor qualification, lifecycle management, performance, risk, financial stewardship, and strategic partnerships across Indero’s vendor ecosystem. Working cross-functionally with operational teams and senior leadership, the Director ensures that vendor services support quality, compliance, scalability, cost effectiveness, and the successful delivery of clinical trials.

More specifically, the Director, Vendor Management must:

  • Adhere to and promote company organizational values and related expected behaviours, follow company standard operating procedures (SOPs) and processes, and ensure all assigned training is completed on time.
  • Own, maintain, and continuously improve Indero’s enterprise vendor governance framework, including governance tiers, oversight models, decision rights, escalation pathways, and supporting standards and tools.
  • Chair vendor governance reviews and lead Vendor Steering Committee activities, ensuring clear decisions, accountability, and follow-up on actions.
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key vendors and preferred partners, establish engagement strategies, and identify opportunities for innovation, enhanced capabilities, and long-term value.
  • Establish vendor performance expectations, key performance indicators (KPIs), service level measures, and scorecards; monitor trends and report performance, risks, and improvement opportunities to relevant stakeholders.
  • Lead vendor performance remediation and continuous improvement initiatives, including root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans, and verification of action effectiveness.
  • Oversee vendor qualification, requalification, onboarding, ongoing oversight, and dequalification processes in collaboration with Quality Assurance and applicable functional teams.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance on vendor audits, compliance activities, inspection readiness, and the timely resolution of audit findings and quality issues.
  • Lead major vendor escalations, monitor systemic and enterprise-level vendor risks, and ensure material risks are communicated to senior leadership with appropriate mitigation and contingency plans.
  • Analyze vendor spend, performance, capacity, and portfolio trends to support vendor selection, sourcing strategies, resource planning, and cost optimization.
  • Contribute vendor strategy and subject matter expertise to requests for proposals, bid defence preparation, study planning, and other business development activities, as applicable.
  • Provide leadership and direction to Vendor Managers, Clinical Procurement Specialists, and other VMO resources, including workforce planning, work allocation, performance management, coaching, development, and succession planning.
  • Build vendor-management capability across the organization through guidance, training, governance forums, and effective collaboration with internal stakeholders.
  • Develop, review, and maintain vendor-management SOPs, tools, templates, processes, and training materials in alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  • Define and monitor VMO objectives, operational metrics, resource needs, and budget requirements, and implement actions to improve quality, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Employee may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, business administration, supply chain, procurement, clinical research, or a related field; Master’s degree is an asset.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and/or contract research organization (CRO) industry, including significant experience in vendor management, procurement, clinical operations, or a related function.
  • Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience, including management of direct and/or indirect reports.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing vendor governance, qualification, oversight, performance management, and risk-management frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial operations, vendor service delivery models, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) guidelines, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with vendor contracting, financial oversight, spend analysis, sourcing strategy, and performance metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization and with external partners.
  • Strong leadership, negotiation, facilitation, communication, and relationship-management skills.
  • Excellent analytical, strategic-thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate risks and develop practical mitigation plans.
  • Very organized and detail-oriented, with effective planning and time-management skills and demonstrated agility in prioritizing multiple competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365; experience with vendor-management, procurement, quality, or reporting systems is an asset.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; French is an asset.

Our company

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Vacation
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

﻿About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology!

﻿Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

﻿Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

﻿Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

﻿Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Canada.

deine aufgaben

Du bist erfahrener SHK-Profi, kennst Wärmepumpen in- und auswendig und hast keine Lust mehr, selbst jeden Tag die Rohre zu biegen? Werde unser „Auge vor Ort“ und hebe die Qualität unserer Partnerbetriebe auf das nächste Level.

  • Qualitätswächter & Auditor: Du bist die entscheidende Kontrollinstanz vor Ort. Du auditierst unsere Partner-Installationsbetriebe direkt auf den Baustellen und stellst sicher, dass unsere hohen Standards eins zu eins umgesetzt werden
  • Partner-Management: Du fährst gezielt Partnerbaustellen im Großraum Süddeutschland an, begutachtest die Ausführung und gibst fachliches Feedback zur Optimierung der Prozesse
  • Partner Onboarding: Du begleitest neue Partnerbetriebe bei ihren ersten Projekten und bringst sie durch deine Hilfestellungen und Feedbacks schnell auf unseren Vamo Standard
  • Sicherstellung der Standards: Dein Ziel ist der Aufbau und Erhalt eines exzellenten Qualitätsniveaus. Du erkennst Abweichungen sofort und wirkst diesen proaktiv entgegen
  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Deine Woche ist klar strukturiert – 4 Tage bist du im Außendienst auf unterschiedlichen Baustellen in Süddeutschland unterwegs, 1 Tag erledigst du alle administrativen Aufgaben aus dem Homeoffice

dein profil

  • Das Wichtigste für uns? Deine Motivation und deine Can-do-Mentalität: Als echter Teamplayer bringst du dich aktiv ein und trägst so gemeinsam zum Erfolg unseres Teams bei. Du denkst in Lösungen statt in Problemen und bist bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

  • Ausbildung: Du bist gelernter Anlagenmechaniker (m/w/d) SHK mit fundierter Berufserfahrung. Idealerweise trägst du einen Meistertitel oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Wärmepumpen-Experte: Ausgeprägte praktische Erfahrung mit Wärmepumpen ist für uns ein Must-Have. Du verstehst die Technik, die Hydraulik und die Besonderheiten der Installation im Detail

  • Kommunikation & Durchsetzungsvermögen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und kannst technische Mängel sachlich, aber bestimmt gegenüber unseren Partnern kommunizieren

  • Mobilität: Ein gültiger Führerschein (Klasse B) sowie eine hohe Reisebereitschaft für den Großraum Süddeutschland sind für diese Rolle zwingend erforderlich

warum wir?

Dein Handwerk. Unser Impact.
Bei uns bist du mittendrin in der Wärmewende und hilfst, echten Impact zu schaffen. Arbeite Hand in Hand mit leidenschaftlichen Kolleg:innen aus Handwerk, Tech und Business. Wir setzen auf offene Kommunikation und flache Hierarchien, um unser Ziel zu erreichen: klimafreundliches Heizen für alle.

Dein Job. Deine Eigenverantwortung.
Du startest direkt von zu Hause zur Baustelle, organisierst deine Aufgaben und deinen Tag selbstständig. Wir haben volles Vertrauen in dein Können.

Sicherheit für die Zukunft.
Dich erwartet ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in unbefristeter Vollzeitanstellung. Du arbeitest in einem schnell wachsenden Zukunftsmarkt mit viel Potenzial für deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung.

Work-Life-Balance 2.0.
Wir sind schnell, anspruchsvoll und direkt. Gleichzeitig bieten wir dir die Freiheit und Eigenverantwortung, die du brauchst, um Beruf und Leben bestmöglich zu kombinieren. Das zeigen wir mit 30 Tagen Urlaub und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

Mehr Benefits. Mehr für dich.
Wir denken Benefits ganzheitlich: Mit dem JobRad-Leasing bleibst du mobil und nachhaltig unterwegs. Zusätzlich erhältst du über die Guudcard monatlich 50 Euro steuerfreien Sachbezug, den du flexibel einsetzen kannst - z.B. für Urban Sports Club, Deutschlandticket oder andere nachhaltige Produkte und Services. Abgerundet wird unser Angebot durch eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss, damit du auch langfristig bestens abgesichert bist.

Ein Team. Eine Mission.
Bei Vamo ziehen alle an einem Strang – egal ob auf der Baustelle, im Büro oder aus dem Home-Office. Unsere unvergesslichen Teamevents bringen uns aus ganz Deutschland zusammen, um unsere gemeinsamen Erfolge zu feiern.

  • Excellent English communication clear writing and confident speaking on video calls with enterprise stakeholders.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Marketing Manager to lead and scale the entire marketing function for a growing B2B managed IT and wireless services company.

This is a high-ownership leadership role designed for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You’ll work directly with the CEO to drive lead generation, strengthen brand awareness, optimize marketing performance, and build scalable systems that contribute directly to pipeline and revenue growth.

This is not a marketing coordinator role. You’ll own marketing strategy, campaign execution, reporting, vendor management, and marketing operations while leveraging AI to improve efficiency and results.

If you enjoy building marketing functions, making data-driven decisions, and creating measurable business impact, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Marketing Strategy & Growth

  • Own the company’s marketing strategy and roadmap.
  • Develop initiatives that drive:
    • Lead generation
    • Pipeline growth
    • Brand awareness
    • Revenue growth

Marketing Analytics & Reporting

    • Lead generation
    • Brand positioning

Webinar & Demand Generation

  • Manage:
    • Registration campaigns
    • Email invitations
    • Reminder sequences
    • Post-event follow-up
  • Coordinate webinar logistics using Zoom.
  • Repurpose webinar recordings into additional marketing assets.
  • Support demand generation initiatives throughout the buyer journey.

CRM & Sales Enablement

  • Manage marketing campaigns inside Salesforce Pardot (MCAE).
  • Build and optimize:
    • Email nurture campaigns
    • Marketing automation workflows
    • Salesforce Sales Engagement cadences
  • Ensure marketing and sales remain aligned throughout the customer journey.
  • Support channel-partner marketing initiatives.

Website & Digital Presence

  • Manage website updates within Webflow.
  • Maintain and optimize:
    • Google Business Profile
    • Local search visibility
  • Monitor and respond to customer reviews.
  • Support future website redesign and company rebranding initiatives.

Contractor & Vendor Management

  • Hire and manage external marketing contractors including:
    • Graphic designers
    • SEO specialists
    • Web developers
    • Copywriters
  • Manage project timelines, budgets, and deliverables.
  • Ensure quality standards across all outsourced work.

Marketing Operations & AI

  • Build scalable marketing systems and workflows.
  • Improve reporting, campaign execution, and content production processes.
  • Leverage AI tools such as:
    • Claude
    • ChatGPT
    • Gemini
  • Use AI to accelerate:
    • Content creation
    • Campaign planning
    • Research
    • Performance analysis
    • Workflow automation
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency and ROI.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of B2B marketing experience.
  • Experience owning or leading a marketing function.
  • Strong understanding of demand generation and revenue marketing.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.
  • Experience creating:
    • LinkedIn content
    • Email newsletters
    • Blog strategies
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Salesforce
    • Salesforce Pardot (MCAE)
    • Salesforce Sales Engagement
    • LinkedIn
    • Webflow
    • Zoom Webinars

    • Google Search Console

  • Strong understanding of marketing analytics and KPI reporting.
  • Experience managing marketing vendors or contractors.
  • Strong knowledge of B2B sales cycles.
  • Active experience integrating AI tools into daily marketing workflows.
  • Ability to explain how AI improves marketing execution and business outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience within:
    • Managed IT Services (MSP)
    • Telecommunications
    • Networking
    • Technology services
  • Experience marketing through:
    • Channel partners
    • VARs
    • Reseller networks
  • SEO knowledge.
  • Experience leading:
    • Company rebrands
    • Website redesigns
    • Website migrations
  • Experience scaling marketing operations for companies between $5M–$50M ARR.
  • Advanced experience with:
    • Claude
    • ChatGPT
    • Gemini
    • AI-powered marketing workflows

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strategic thinker who enjoys executing.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven.
  • Comfortable owning an entire marketing function.
  • Strong business judgment and prioritization skills.
  • Self-starter who thrives with autonomy.
  • Organized and capable of managing multiple priorities.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborator.
  • Curious, resourceful, and continuously learning.
  • Naturally looks for ways to improve marketing systems and performance.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review marketing dashboards and KPI performance.
  • Create and schedule LinkedIn content.
  • Manage email marketing campaigns and newsletters.
  • Coordinate webinar planning and promotion.
  • Update website content in Webflow.
  • Meet with contractors and review deliverables.
  • Analyze campaign performance and pipeline contribution.
  • Collaborate with leadership on growth initiatives.
  • Identify optimization opportunities.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate planning, content creation, reporting, and decision-making.

In short: You own the company’s marketing engine—driving demand generation, content, marketing operations, and measurable pipeline growth while continuously improving systems and performance.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs)
  • Marketing pipeline contribution
  • LinkedIn audience growth and engagement
  • Newsletter open and click-through rates
  • Webinar registrations and attendance
  • Website traffic and organic search growth
  • Lead conversion rates
  • Google Business Profile engagement
  • Campaign ROI
  • Marketing efficiency and execution quality

Why Join Us?

  • Direct collaboration with executive leadership.
  • Full ownership of the marketing function.
  • Opportunity to build and scale a modern B2B marketing engine.
  • Budget authority to hire and manage specialized contractors.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Opportunity to lead future rebranding and website transformation initiatives.
  • High-impact role with significant long-term growth potential.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Final Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

Assessment Process

Finalists will receive a sample monthly KPI report before the final interview. During the interview, you’ll discuss your priorities, recommendations, growth opportunities, and strategic decisions based on the data provided.

The assessment is designed to evaluate your marketing judgment, analytical thinking, and decision-making, rather than presentation design or memorization.

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

About Fastn

Fastn is on a mission to revolutionize how SaaS companies connect with their customers' environments. Powered by AI, we provide an embedded integration infrastructure that enables SaaS businesses to build, scale, and manage their integration ecosystem effortlessly.

With Fastn, companies can launch strategic integrations, create their own app marketplace, and unlock new revenue streams by offering seamless connectivity with the tools their customers already use. But our platform is more than just integrationsit’s about accelerating market penetration, driving partner-sourced revenue, and delivering smarter, more valuable customer experiences.

If you’re passionate about bridging the gap between technology, business, and customer success in a high-scale SaaS environment, Fastn is the place to be.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will serve as a technical expert and strategic partner for customers, helping them design and implement seamless integrations using Fastn’s AI-powered platform. You will work closely with engineering, product, sales, and customer success teams to ensure that customers can effectively leverage Fastn to build high-performance, scalable integration solutions.

  • Develop Proof of Concepts: Build and demonstrate proof-of-concept (PoC) integrations, showcasing Fastn’s capabilities and assisting customers in implementation.
  • Optimize for Scalability and Performance: Design solutions that handle millions of transactions per second/minute with sub-millisecond latency.
  • Drive API and Automation Excellence: Assist customers in leveraging Fastn’s APIs, AI-powered automation, and smart connectivity features.
  • Ensure Security and Compliance: Implement best practices for API security, authentication (OAuth, JWT, OpenID), and compliance (SOC 2, GDPR, etc.).
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with engineering and product teams to provide customer feedback and contribute to product improvements.
  • Educate and Enable: Train customers, partners, and internal teams on best practices for using Fastn’s integration platform effectively.
  • Mentor and Lead: Share best practices, mentor junior solution engineers, and contribute to documentation and technical leadership.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a highly skilled and customer-facing technical leader who excels at designing scalable SaaS integration architectures. If you thrive at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and customer success, this role is for you.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, or enterprise integration.
  • Strong background in API architecture, RESTful & GraphQL APIs, and event-driven integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with backend development in Java, Python, or Node.js.

  • Experience designing solutions that handle high-scale, low-latency transactions.
  • Familiarity with iPaaS platforms (Mulesoft, Workato, Tray.io, etc.) and automation workflows.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with AI-driven automation and API intelligence.

  • Background in B2B SaaS integrations and developer tooling.

  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures, message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.), and real-time data processing.

  • Hands-on experience with low-code and no-code integration platforms.

Why Join Fastn?

  • Shape the Future of SaaS Connectivity Define how SaaS companies scale their integration ecosystems.
  • Work on Cutting-Edge AI & API Technologies Solve complex connectivity challenges using AI-powered automation.
  • High-Impact, Strategic Role Directly influence customer success and Fastn’s technical strategy.
  • Strong Engineering Culture Collaborate with world-class engineers solving large-scale technical challenges.
  • Competitive Compensation Market-leading salary, meaningful equity, and a flexible remote work environment.

Join Us in Building the Future of SaaS Connectivity!

If you’re excited to architect high-scale SaaS solutions, drive technical strategy, and help customers succeed, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help shape the future of SaaS integrations!

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.

In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

You will work with Kotlin and Java, integrate mobile applications with backend services through RESTful APIs, and contribute to reliable, maintainable mobile solutions.

You will collaborate with distributed engineering teams, participate in Agile delivery processes, and take ownership of debugging, code quality, and technical implementation.

The role is suitable for candidates based in the EU with EU nationality. Occasional travel to the client's office in Sweden may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Android applications using Kotlin and Java.
  • Build reliable, maintainable, and well-structured mobile application components.
  • Work extensively with the Android SDK and established Android development practices.
  • Integrate Android applications with backend services using RESTful APIs.
  • Implement and maintain application data flows and local persistence where required.
  • Work with SQL databases as part of mobile application functionality.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex application issues.
  • Identify and address performance, stability, and usability problems.
  • Write clean and maintainable code aligned with software engineering standards.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Use Git and established version-control workflows.
  • Collaborate with backend developers, QA engineers, product stakeholders, and other mobile developers.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, planning, estimation, and iterative delivery.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of development practices and engineering quality.
  • Support application testing, release preparation, and production issue resolution.

Essential Requirements

  • At least 5 years of professional Android development experience.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience working with the Android SDK.
  • Strong Kotlin programming skills.
  • Strong Java programming skills.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs.
  • Proficient understanding of Git and code versioning workflows.
  • Practical experience working with SQL databases.
  • Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles and development practices.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within distributed engineering teams.
  • Fluent English, both spoken and written.
  • EU nationality and ability to work from within the EU.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to Sweden when required.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience developing and maintaining large-scale or business-critical Android applications.
  • Familiarity with modern Android application architecture and modular application design.
  • Experience with automated testing for Android applications.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Understanding of mobile application performance optimisation and reliability practices.
  • Experience collaborating closely with backend and QA teams.
  • Previous experience working in telecommunications or similarly complex technical environments.

What We Value

We value developers who combine strong Android engineering skills with a practical approach to solving technical problems. Code quality, maintainability, reliability, and careful debugging are important parts of this role.

Clear communication and collaboration are equally important. You should be comfortable working independently in a remote setup while contributing actively to technical discussions and Agile team delivery.

What You Can Expect

  • Hands-on Android development using Kotlin, Java, and the Android SDK.
  • Work on a telecommunications project within an international engineering environment.
  • Collaboration with distributed technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Exposure to backend integrations, APIs, databases, and complex application workflows.
  • A remote-first working model.
  • Occasional business travel to Sweden.
  • Opportunity to contribute to technical decisions and ongoing engineering improvements.

What We Offer

  • Project / Industry: Telecommunications project for an end customer in Sweden.
  • Location: Remote within the EU, with occasional visits to Sweden.
  • Contract Type: B2B contractor.
  • Compensation: €40–45/hour.
  • Start Date: Preferred start between the end of September and October.
  • Work Model: Remote.
  • Contract Duration: 6 months, with the possibility of extension.

Recruitment Process

  • CV Screening: Applications are reviewed within 24 hours.
  • Pre-Screening Interview: A brief Q&A session, automated or with a recruiter, designed to learn more about your experience related to the position.
    1. Automated Session (Recommended) – You can complete the session independently at a convenient time. The structured questions and follow-ups are designed to capture detailed, role-relevant experience and can support faster hiring-manager feedback.
    2. Session with a Recruiter – You can complete the same pre-screening with a recruiter. The discussion may be less detailed and feedback may take slightly longer.
  • Shortlisting: Qualified candidates are presented to the hiring manager for review.
  • Formal Interviews: Discussions with the hiring manager or project team, with feedback typically provided within 1–2 weeks.
  • Offer and Onboarding: Successful candidates receive a formal offer and begin the onboarding process.

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission
Kong is scaling rapidly. We are building a world-class revenue engine, and to do that, we need a GTM Sourcing Recruiter who doesn't just fill seats but identifies elite talent. Our sales organization operates on MEDDIC. We believe that rigorous qualification applies just as much to hiring as it does to selling. We are looking for a talent partner who can audit a candidate’s GTM acumen, dig into their operational and executional mechanics, and ensure they have the DNA to drive big wins and make a big impact.

The Role
As a GTM Recruiter, you will help own the hiring strategy for some of our most critical roles in the CRO org. You will act as a strategic advisor to our GTM Leaders and you won’t just be passing over resumes; you will be conducting deep-dive competency interviews to ensure every candidate we hire raises the bar.

What You Will Do

1. Strategic Sourcing & Headhunting

  • Build and nurture a pipeline of top talent

  • Map out competitor sales orgs and execute targeted headhunting campaigns.

  • Sell the Kong vision, equity story, and product value to passive candidates who aren't actively looking.

2. Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with GTM Leadership to define "What Good Looks Like" for each specific role, region, and function.

  • Provide real-time market data to hiring managers regarding salary bands, talent density, and competitor compensation.

  • Challenge hiring managers when necessary - you are the expert on talent.

3. Thorough Candidate Assessment

  • Go beyond the resume: Assess candidates on their specific deal mechanics. (e.g., "Who was the Economic Buyer in your biggest win?""What Metrics did you use to build the business case?")

  • Filter out drivers from passengers, lucky sellers from strategic sellers, etc. by digging into their process, business, and achievements.

4. Operational Excellence

  • Drive a rigorous interview process that balances speed with quality.

  • Help Educate and Mentor other recruiters on GTM terminology, objection handling, and closing strategies.

  • Track conversion metrics to optimize the funnel (e.g., Passthrough Rates)

What you will bring

  • Experience: GTM Sourcing experience, with a heavy focus on B2B SaaS / Enterprise Software Sales.

  • Methodology Native: You are fluent in MEDDIC / MEDDPICC. You know the difference between a Champion and a Coach, and you know how to test a candidate's grasp of these concepts.

  • Scale-Up Resilient: You thrive in ambiguity. You can build a plane while flying it and adapt quickly when priorities change.

  • Hunter Mentality: You don’t rely on inbound applicants. You enjoy the hunt and have a creative toolkit for finding hidden talent.

  • Data-Driven: You use data to influence decisions and track your own performance.

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For us, the days of “fit in to get in” are over and being different is not a barrier to getting ahead. Greatness comes in all shapes, sizes, colors, and experience levels. If you are looking for a people-first culture that is wired for growth, driven to serve, and totally committed to having your back, give us a shot. Your best life awaits.


Must be eligible to work in the United States without the need for work visa or residency sponsorship.


We kindly ask that external recruiters, agencies, and search firms do not contact our hiring managers or employees directly regarding open positions. All candidate submissions must go through our official application process and must be made aware to our internal Talent Acquisition team to verify candidate ownership.

Unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles sent to OneDigital without a prior signed agreement will be considered the property of OneDigital. In such cases, OneDigital reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidates without any financial obligation to the agency or recruiter.


Our Newest Opportunity:

Summary:

This role manages the day-to-day execution of requests for proposals (RFPs), requests for information (RFIs), and Due Diligence Questionnaires that support prospective client business development efforts across OneDigital's Financial Services practice but primarily retirement plans, including defined contribution, defined benefit, and related institutional business. This role partners closely with the RFP and Proposal Strategy Manager and cross-functional contributors to deliver polished, submission-ready responses on deadline.This role manages pursuit intake, applies an established triage model, coordinates end-to-end fulfillment, and maintains the integrity of the compliance-approved content library. This is a role for someone who wants to build real depth in Financial Services business development, starting close to the work and growing toward greater complexity, process ownership, and strategic contribution over time.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (includes but is not limited to):

Intake, Triage & Timeline Management

  • Manage pursuit intake and apply the established triage rubric to route each opportunity to the appropriate lane: self-service, assisted, or strategic.
  • Manage pursuit timelines end to end, coordinating dependencies across contributing teams and practice areas for cross-practice and converged bids.
  • Flag capacity or timeline risk early so the Strategy Manager can rebalance workload before a deadline is at risk.
  • Coordinate pursuit kickoffs and establish clear roles, responsibilities, deadlines, and dependencies across all contributors.
  • Maintain accurate pursuit tracking and status information — including deadlines, outcomes, resource requirements, and content usage — to support reporting and capacity planning.

Fulfillment, Content & Production

  • Create, assemble, and complete responses from the compliance-approved content library, coordinating with cross-functional partners and internal systems as needed.
  • Maintain the day-to-day integrity of the compliance-approved content library, flagging stale, missing, or inconsistent content for the Strategy Manager's review.
  • Coordinate with Compliance and subject matter experts on net-new responses where no compliance-approved content exists, escalating substantive content and positioning questions to the Strategy Manager.
  • Use approved AI tools to accelerate drafting, research, formatting, and quality checks — always within Compliance-set guardrails and with appropriate human review.
  • Assemble reference and bio packages, pulling from the maintained roster and case-study library.
  • Coordinate sample and custom materials for each business development opportunity — case studies, fee exhibits, comparison matrices, and similar deliverables.
  • Support the Strategy Manager in maintaining the case-study library, referenceable-client roster, and other reusable pursuit materials.
  • Own final formatting, proofing, brand and template compliance, and packaging of every submission-ready document.
  • Coordinate final submission logistics, ensuring required materials, approvals, signatures, and supporting documents are complete and submitted accurately and on time.

Quality Control, Compliance Routing & Archiving

  • Perform quality-control reviews of drafts and final submissions for completeness, consistency, formatting, and adherence to established standards.
  • Flag regulated or Compliance-sensitive content early and route it appropriately, using review-only-the-delta practices wherever possible.
  • Manage supplemental follow-up questionnaires after the first round of a pursuit.
  • Populate the content library and business development systems with completed deliverables and reusable information, ensuring materials are properly tagged and available for future pursuits.
  • Support win/loss debriefs and reporting, capturing themes and stale-content flags for the Strategy Manager.

Qualifications, Skills and Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in proposal coordination, business development, sales or marketing operations, or a comparable deadline-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce, develop, or fulfill proposal, RFP, or prospect-facing materials.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to edit, synthesize, and improve complex content while preserving the intent of the underlying response.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and accountability across multiple simultaneous deadlines.
  • Sound judgment about when to proceed independently and when to escalate questions, risks, or exceptions.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills, a high sense of urgency, and a track record of following through in deadline-driven environments.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, OneNote).
  • Familiarity with proposal management, sales enablement, CRM, or content management platforms; experience with Responsive, Seismic, or Salesforce is preferred.
  • Comfort learning and working within compliance-driven content standards is required.
  • Experience with or exposure to retirement plans (defined contribution, defined benefit), wealth management, or institutional investing audiences is preferred.
  • Understanding of Financial Services regulatory context and compliance requirements as they apply to business development and client-facing materials is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

Education, Training and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, English, Finance, or a related field required; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • Experience working within or alongside Financial Services — particularly retirement plans (defined contribution or defined benefit) — is preferred.
  • Familiarity with compliance-approved content workflows or regulated content environments is a plus.
  • APMP certification or comparable proposal management training is a plus.

The typical base pay range for this role nationwide is $70,000 to $80,000 per year.

Your base pay is dependent upon your skills, education, qualifications, professional experience, and location. In addition to base pay, some roles are eligible for variable compensation, commission, and/or annual bonus based on your individual performance and/or the company’s performance. We also offer eligible employees health, wellbeing, retirement, and other financial benefits, paid time off, overtime pay for non-exempt employees, and robust learning and development programs. Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Software Quality Assurance Engineer to independently execute and take expanded ownership of quality assurance and test automation activities on the BASIS program. Operating with minimal supervision, the QA Engineer carries direct responsibility for automated test design and delivery, test documentation ownership, defect lifecycle management, and security testing integration — all in support of the program's automation-first QA mandate. All quality assurance activities must be automated.

The selected candidate will independently manage test automation deliverables across Agile sprint cycles, contribute to QA strategy discussions, support junior engineers, and interface with developers and Government stakeholders on quality metrics and release readiness across the deployment pipeline.

This is a 100% remote role.

Test Automation Development & Strategy

  • Independently design, develop, implement, and maintain automated test scripts for unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end functional testing across the application portfolio.
  • Ensure all automated test cases are executable by the end of each Agile sprint and fully integrated into the Government-managed DevSecOps pipeline with minimal oversight.
  • Drive and apply Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodology — authoring test cases prior to code development and collaborating closely with software engineers to align test coverage with functional requirements.
  • Lead the Test Automation State Assessment for assigned application areas; produce assessment reports with automation completion estimates.
  • Own the automation of adjacent legacy test cases per Government-approved schedules to systematically expand regression coverage across the portfolio.
  • Evaluate automation approaches and recommend improvements to test architecture, reusability, and pipeline integration within the Government-provided automation framework.
  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor to junior QA engineers on automation best practices, test script development, and tool usage.

Test Planning & Documentation

  • Develop and own Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) at the end of each development cycle/sprint, ensuring full traceability and complete testing coverage of all functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Document all test activities, execution results, and defect findings within the Government-provided Test Case Management System with accuracy and completeness.
  • Independently prepare Testing Reports, Release Notes (Draft and Final), and Software Version Descriptions (SVDs) per release cadence requirements.

Quality Assurance & Defect Management

  • Enforce and monitor hard contractual quality thresholds with zero defects released to production.
  • Lead defect triage and root cause analysis in JIRA; manage the full escalation workflow to product teams with complete documentation and submit JIRA tickets prior to all escalations.
  • Own and submit weekly defect escalation reports to customers and the Government Product Owner.

Section 508 / Accessibility Testing

  • Lead Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing at planned intervals throughout the development lifecycle, ensuring continuous integration of accessibility compliance into the QA process.
  • Own preparation of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) including test results, remediation reports, and conformance level documentation for all applicable deliverables.
  • Report Section 508 compliance testing status and metrics.

Performance & Environment Testing

  • Lead stress and load testing activities in the ProdSim (Production Simulation) environment; prepare and submit detailed test schedules for Government approval and execute per approved schedule.
  • Coordinate and support Disaster Recovery (DR) testing activities in collaboration with technical and operations teams.
  • Support Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) of all application prior to production deployment; ensure all IV&V findings are tracked and resolved.

Agile / DevSecOps Participation

  • Actively contribute to and help facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Maintain sprint-level defect tracking, test case completion status, and burn-down metrics in JIRA; provide QA-focused sprint reporting to program leadership.
  • Enforce quality gates across the SDLC pipeline; flag and escalate non-conforming deliverables before stage promotion.
  • Own and submit monthly Quality Status Report (QSR).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, test automation engineering, or related software testing roles with BS/BA, 3 years with MS/MA
  • Must be US CItizen
  • Active Public Trust clearance
  • Cybersecurity workforce certification (e.g., Security+, CASP+)
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks and scripts using tools such as Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Cucumber, Python, Java, or equivalent.
  • Working knowledge of Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices and their application within Agile sprint cycles.
  • Proficiency with JIRA for defect tracking, sprint management, and reporting.
  • Experience developing Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs), UAT plans, and formal testing documentation.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated test integration within a DevSecOps environment.
  • Experience with Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Level AA accessibility testing and VPAT preparation.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills; ability to report QA status and metrics to program leadership and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) Foundation or Advanced Level certification.
  • Experience supporting DoD or Federal government IT programs with formal QA deliverable obligations.
  • Familiarity with eMASS and Fortify Software Security Center for vulnerability tracking and POA&M management.
  • Prior experience in or exposure to DEERS, TRICARE, or other DoD healthcare/benefits systems.
  • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 security controls as they relate to application testing and compliance.
  • Experience with performance/load testing tools and stress test execution in production-simulation environments.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow for incident management and tracking.
  • Experience mentoring junior QA team members and reviewing test artifacts for quality and completeness.

About Us:

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.

Job Description:

This senior leadership role will drive new revenue growth and commercialization across insightsoftware's product portfolio for the Office of the CFO. You will own the strategy and execution for launching new products and new revenue streams, including the monetization of AI-enabled capabilities, and drive them from concept to material annual recurring revenue. As the portfolio undergoes a major brand and platform transformation toward a unified, AI-native experience, this leader ensures that new capabilities convert to durable, profitable revenue.

This leader pairs deep product judgment with commercial rigor across pricing and packaging, go-to-market design, and disciplined launch execution. The ideal candidate is fluent in applying AI both to the products we ship and to the way the team works, has a track record of standing up new revenue streams, and reports performance to executive leadership and the board. They must exude an unrelenting passion for our customer experience, strong financial acumen, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ownership and accountability for the strategy, P&L, and commercialization plan for new products and new revenue streams across the portfolio.
  • Define monetization models, pricing, and packaging for new and AI-enabled capabilities, with explicit measures for genuinely monetized revenue.
  • Own the launch Go/No-Go gate and pricing validation, and the post-launch growth plan that scales adoption into revenue.
  • Build the business cases for new products, features, and inorganic opportunities, and lead build, buy, and partner decisions.
  • Set the standard for AI fluency across the team, using AI to compress cycle time across discovery, delivery, and go-to-market.
  • Work closely and collaboratively with marketing, sales, customer success, and services to execute acquisition, retention, and expansion strategies and meet revenue targets.
  • Maintain a competitive market overview to identify white spaces, pricing opportunities, and strategic threats.
  • Report new-revenue and commercialization performance to executive leadership and the board, including ARR, win rates, attach, and adoption.
  • Assess risks and dependencies across product, engineering, and go-to-market functions and provide guidance to Business Unit leadership.

KEY AREAS OF FOCUS:

NEW REVENUE STREAM LAUNCH

  • Identifies, validates, and launches new revenue streams, owning the offer, pricing, packaging, and the path from first dollar to scaled ARR.
  • Designs and runs the commercialization motion, including offer and SKU design, sales enablement, and adoption tracking, so new capabilities reliably convert to revenue.
  • Establishes the measures that separate genuinely monetized revenue from bundled or attributed revenue, and reports against them.

AI MONETIZATION AND AI-NATIVE PRODUCT

  • Builds the business case and operating model for monetizing AI-enabled capabilities, balancing customer value, willingness to pay, and cost to serve.
  • Shapes an AI-native product strategy, partnering with engineering and platform leaders on the data, evaluation, and governance foundations required to ship trustworthy AI.
  • Defines how AI value is measured and connects AI investment to adoption and revenue.

PRODUCT COMMERCIALIZATION AND GO-TO-MARKET

  • Owns pricing and packaging validation at launch and the cross-functional readiness required for a successful release.
  • Manages across channels to define and deliver product performance goals (for example revenue, attach, and customer experience).
  • Leverages enterprise platforms and capabilities to improve speed to market and drive development and ongoing support cost efficiencies.

PRODUCT STRATEGY, VISION, AND PLANNING

  • Pulls from market and competitive insights, customer needs, and business priorities to shape the portfolio's growth strategy and investment areas.
  • Aligns the strategy with cross-functional stakeholders to shape the roadmap and success measures.
  • Understands the product technical architecture and the economics of technical investments, for example buy vs. build and total cost of ownership.

TEAM LEADERSHIP

  • Build and lead a high-performing team across product management and product marketing, providing mentorship, guidance, and support.
  • Foster a culture of commercial rigor, innovation, and disciplined use of AI in everyday work.
  • Identify and develop talent, ensuring the team has the skills and resources needed to hit revenue objectives.

STAKEHOLDER COLLABORATION

  • Collaborate closely with executive leadership, engineering, marketing, sales, and customer success to ensure alignment on revenue objectives.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Business Unit leadership and the board on commercialization and new revenue.

Qualifications

  • Experience owning direct P&L responsibility for a product line, business unit, or division within a B2B software company.
  • 10+ years of experience in product management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role focused on growth, monetization, or commercialization.
  • Demonstrated success launching new products and new revenue streams and scaling them to material ARR, including subscription and usage-based or AI-enabled monetization.
  • Strong pricing and packaging expertise, with a track record of pricing decisions that improved attach, conversion, or margin.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: has used AI to improve product and team outcomes, and has shipped or monetized AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, economics, or a related field. An MBA or similar advanced degree is preferred.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills in a complex, matrixed, global software environment.
  • Analytical, data-driven mindset with strong financial acumen, attention to detail, and prioritization skills.

For sales roles, this range includes the commission target. For non-sales roles, this is a base salary only range; additional bonus eligibility may apply.

Skills

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? The Role

We are seeking an experienced English into Kyrgyz Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.

You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”.   • Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
    -Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
    -Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
    -Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
    -Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.

    -The community’s shared understanding of quality

    - Analytical approach:     Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
    - Language:     Native-levelKyrgyz and professional-level English
    - Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools

Additional Key Information

Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.

Why Join Us

This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing training, and access to established linguistic resources.

Join Our Team as aDirector Business Development - IMN (Internal Medicine and Neuroscience) - (home based in Germany or Switzerland).

About this role

As part of our CDS Internal Medicine and Neuroscienceteam you will be working alongside passionate and innovative professionals to ensure our customers achieve their goals.

The Director Business Development - IMN (Internal Medicine and Neuroscience)is responsible for the business development strategy and client retention in an allocated sales territory or with specified accounts. Responsible for the coordination of all activities delegated to business development staff.

If you have a a strong network within IMN (Internal Medicine and Neuroscience) - I want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Initiates, coordinates and develops strategic plans and sales strategies within a specified territory or accounts

  • Meet annual sales goals and objectives

  • Identify new business sales opportunities for TFS and to work with the internal TFS team to respond appropriately to any enquiry, For example a Request for Information (RFI) or a Request for Proposal (RFP)

  • Facilitate the preparedness of the TFS team in attending any client meetings. For example Capabilities meetings or Bid Defense Meetings (BDM)

  • Coordinate and monitor any budget or contract negotiations, post award of any work to TFS within a specified territory or accounts

  • Establish and maintain regular contact and an excellent rapport with future and current clients

  • Prepare and organize sponsor presentations

  • Collect critical information for proposal preparation

  • Understand the RFI/RFP process and toprovide detailed input and leadership of the proposal process for each opportunity initiated

  • Manage costs e.g. expenses appropriately and to submit claims in a timely manner

  • Positively interact with TFS operations personnel, keeping track of study status for projects with sponsors and help coordinate change orders when notified of a change of scope by operations

  • Monitor and track competitor CRO activities

  • Plan and attend major industrial events and tradeshows as budgeted and required

  • Develop account strategies & implementation plans and expand through accounts

  • Identify new markets and researches new business opportunities, identifies likely sales points within a specified territory or accounts

  • Coordinate and supervise all activities aiming to develop and retain clients

  • Collects, compiles, analyzes and presents data related to business development

  • Record all activities and client contacts in the Customer Relationship Management system ()

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or highly relevant industry experience

  • Minimum of five (5) years of clinical research and/or sales experience

  • Considerable sales experience of more than 3 years with strong negotiation and analytical skills

  • Excellent communication skills and team leadership capabilities consistent with influencing and driving multiple stakeholders towards meeting the customer’s needs

  • Excellent organisational, planning and multitasking skills, as well as a predisposition to entrepreneurship, results and customer focus

  • Excellent knowledge of TFS / CRO business

  • Computer competency and familiarity with Microsoft Office

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Awareness of trends andgovernment policies and regulations in the clinical trials area of TFS Group countries

  • Ability to work independently and efficiently

  • Good planning, organization and problem solving abilities

  • Excellent English and German written and verbal communication skills

  • Strongand effective presentation skills; ability to convincingly present features and benefits of service to clients

  • Travel according to the needs of the business development strategy and to travel extensively within the sales territory and to company meetings as required

What We Offer

We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You’ll be joining a team that values collaboration, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of patients

A Bit More About Us

Our journey began over 30 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a full-service, global Contract Research Organization (CRO), we build solution-driven teams working towards a healthier future. Bringing together over 600 professionals, TFS delivers tailored clinical research services in more than 50 countries with flexible clinical development and strategic resourcing solutions across key therapeutic areas including Dermatology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology.

Our core values of Trust, Quality, Passion, Flexibility, and Sustainability are our guiding light serving as the framework for decision-making at all levels of the organization. They assist us in attracting and retaining valuable talent who share our sentiments, resulting in high employee engagement and satisfaction. By aligning on these fundamental values, we cultivate a unified force, geared towards innovation and excellence. This collective effort propels us towards our shared goal and fosters a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.

Together we make a difference.

raw.title: Technical Writer - SCADA
raw.excerpt: Working under the direction of the Chief Information and Innovation Officer and the Product Manager, the SCADA Technical Writer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving technical documentation supporting Trimark's SCADA solutions for utility-scale renewable energy projects.
raw.description:
Working under the direction of the Chief Information and Innovation Officer and the Product Manager, the SCADA Technical Writer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving technical documentation supporting Trimark's SCADA solutions for utility-scale renewable energy projects. The SCADA Technical Writer works closely with SCADA engineers, software developers, project managers, and subject matter experts to create clear, accurate, and professional control narratives, HMI narratives, operating procedures, system descriptions, and customer-facing documentation that communicates complex system functionality and operational workflows.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with SCADA engineers, software developers, project managers, and other technical personnel to gather, organize, and document technical information.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation including system descriptions, commissioning procedures, user guides, standard operating descriptions, and customer deliverables.
  • Create, maintain, and improve control narratives, HMI narratives, system architecture documentation, and operational workflows.
  • Review and enhance block diagrams, communications architectures, system workflows, and related engineering documentation to improve clarity, completeness, and usability.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear documentation suitable for customers, operators, technicians, engineers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Participate in design reviews, project meetings, and engineering discussions to ensure documentation accurately reflects system functionality and project requirements.
  • Maintain document revision history and version control throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and compliance with company documentation standards and customer requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams to stay informed of product enhancements, software releases, and system modifications.
  • Support continuous improvement of documentation processes, templates, and standards.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Support organizational culture, values, and reputation in its markets and with all staff, customers, suppliers, partners, and regulatory bodies.
  • Demonstrate strong interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with all levels of management, staff, customers, and partners.
  • Work collaboratively across engineering, operations, and project teams.
  • Represent the Trimark Associates brand professionally to customers and vendors.
  • Periodically communicate activities and project status to leadership.
  • Respond to calls, emails, and messages in a timely manner.
  • Support documentation management and maintenance of project records and databases.

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Technical Communications, Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered. Requires professional experience creating technical documentation within industrial automation, SCADA, controls engineering, power systems, renewable energy, or other highly technical environments.

The successful candidate must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to understand and document complex technical systems. Experience working with industrial control systems, SCADA platforms, control narratives, HMI narratives, communications networks, and engineering documentation is highly desirable.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States of America. This position is not eligible for sponsorship of a work visa.

Preferred qualifications include familiarity with utility-scale solar, battery energy storage systems (BESS), microgrids, power generation facilities, industrial communications protocols, and document control practices. Candidates should demonstrate the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.

About Trimark

Trimark is an industry leader in the movement towards a greener grid and a cleaner future. We design systems and provide services to enable the integration of large-scale renewable power plants into the power grid. Our products are at the forefront of generating dispatchable power from renewable plants by combining the intermittent renewable resource with energy storage. We manage thousands of renewable energy sites for industry-leading clients and support regulatory and operational compliance solutions for complex systems associated with critical infrastructure – electric loads, power generation, water infrastructure and other similar applications.

Trimark provides systems and services that power producers, utility providers, and independent load serving entities need to participate in organized electric markets, as well as the information ISO’s and Balancing Authorities need to manage the bulk electric grids. Our team designs systems from concept to commissioning, including system and network architecture, software development, component assembly, technology configuration, installation, testing, certification, ongoing support, and maintenance.

Equal Opportunity

Trimark is committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all people involved in Company operations and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company, including supervisors and coworkers.

E-Verify

Trimark will provide the Social Security Administration, and if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security, with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization. Please note that we do not use this information to pre-screen job applicants.

Work Authorization

This role is Not Eligible for sponsorship by Trimark, including future sponsorship. Candidates must reside in the United States.

Pay Transparency

Compensation is based on market rate, job level, job related knowledge, skills, experience, education, and certifications.

Candidate Safety

Trimark engages in a structured hiring process during which you will meet with multiple team members. We do not issue offers based on email contact and will not ask for your personal or sensitive information prior to an accepted offer. Communications from our talent team will come from the trimarkassoc.com domains.

Unsolicited Candidate Referrals

Trimark values our strategic partnerships with our agency partners who may supplement our internal recruitment team’s efforts from time to time. To submit candidates for consideration, agency partners must have an executed agreement signed by Trimark’s president and a job specific requisition. Without such agreements in place, Trimark will not pay a fee to any agency. Unsolicited referrals from any source other than directly from a candidate will be considered Trimark property and will be considered to have been referred by the agency free of any charge or fee. This includes resumes, partial resumes, candidate profiles, and candidate details or information.

Salary: $90,000 - $115,000 per year

description: At HVAC RNTL, we move fast—delivering commercial HVAC rental solutions when and where they’re needed most.

raw.title: Applied Solutions Sales Manager
raw.excerpt: At HVAC RNTL, we move fast—delivering commercial HVAC rental solutions when and where they’re needed most.
raw.description:
At HVAC RNTL, we move fast—delivering commercial HVAC rental solutions when and where they’re needed most. From one-ton spot coolers to large-scale chillers and cooling towers, our team responds with speed and precision, whether it’s a planned project or a 24/7 emergency.

If you’re wired for problem-solving and thrive in a fast-paced environment, you’ll fit right in. Our people set us apart—and with locations across the U.S., there’s room to grow, take on big challenges, and make an immediate impact.

Applied Solutions Sales Manager

Remote / Travel / HQ Irving, TX

At HVAC RNTL, we're looking for an experienced HVAC sales manager who loves developing people, solving technical problems, working with customers, and growing a business.

This isn't a role where you'll spend your days managing people through reports and dashboards.

We want someone who wants to get into the field.

You'll travel with your sales team, walk jobs, meet customers, help think through complex temporary HVAC applications, develop territories, coach people, and help us decide where we should invest and grow next.

And you'll need to know HVAC.

Our Applied customers rely on us for more than equipment. They expect us to understand their systems, ask the right questions, anticipate challenges, and bring together the right equipment, people, and expertise to develop a solution that works.

You don't need to personally engineer every project or have every answer. But you should be comfortable talking about chillers, boilers, air handlers, pumps, airflow, water flow, temperature, pressure, power, controls, temporary distribution, and how these pieces interact in a temporary HVAC application.

If you've spent your career around commercial HVAC, that should feel natural.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Develop a Great Sales Team

  • Lead and develop a geographically dispersed team of Applied HVAC sales professionals.
  • Spend significant time in the field coaching through customer visits, ride-alongs, job walks, and opportunity planning.
  • Recruit great people and help them build successful careers here.
  • Set clear expectations and hold people accountable.
  • Coach people who are struggling and help high performers continue growing.
  • Make the difficult people decisions that come with being a manager when necessary.
  • Identify and develop the next generation of leaders.
  • Build a team where people share knowledge, support one another, and enjoy winning together.

Help Your Team Solve Technical HVAC Problems

  • Work alongside representatives on complex temporary heating and cooling applications.
  • Help the team understand the customer's complete system and the problem we're trying to solve.
  • Ask the questions that help us get scope right before equipment arrives onsite.
  • Recognize when additional technical, operational, engineering, or safety resources need to be involved.
  • Help continually raise the technical capability of the sales organization.

Grow the Business

  • Own revenue growth and commercial performance across your markets.
  • Establish budgets, forecasts, territory plans, and growth expectations.
  • Help representatives develop their territories and customer relationships.
  • Identify new geographies, verticals, customers, and applications where HVAC RNTL can win.
  • Support major projects and strategic opportunities.
  • Help leadership understand where fleet and resources should be invested based on what you're seeing in the market.

Stay Close to Customers

  • Build relationships with contractors, engineers, facility leaders, end users, and strategic partners.
  • Be in front of customers with your team.
  • Help navigate technically complex projects and difficult customer situations.
  • Encourage the team to solve the customer's problem rather than simply rent them a piece of equipment.
  • Make it easy for customers to do business with us.

How We Lead

Our four Core Values are central to what we're building.

Prioritize People Know your team. Invest in them. Coach them. Challenge them. Help them grow. Hold people accountable while remembering there is always a person behind the number.

Own the Customer Experience Don't pass problems around. Take ownership, bring the right people together, communicate, follow through, and make it right.

Build Better Together Applied HVAC is a team sport. Sales, Operations, Service, technical resources, vendors, and customers all bring something to the table. We expect our leaders to collaborate, share expertise, and make the whole team better.

Deliver Results Move with urgency. Make decisions. Close loops. Keep commitments. Find solutions and get things done.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who has actually lived in the HVAC world.

You should bring strong commercial HVAC knowledge along with a proven history of leading people. Ideally, you've worked in HVAC rental, applied equipment, mechanical contracting, commercial service, or another technical HVAC environment.

You should also have experience doing the real work of management—hiring people, developing them, promoting strong performers, addressing poor performance, making difficult personnel decisions, setting budgets, forecasting the business, and being accountable for your team's results.

Just as importantly, we're looking for someone who is professional, collaborative, curious, technically credible, comfortable with customers, and genuinely enjoys helping other people succeed.

Why HVAC RNTL?

We're not trying to become another big-box rental company.

We're building a focused HVAC organization where talented people have the ability to think, make decisions, solve problems, and take care of customers.

We believe accountability matters. Results matter. Technical excellence matters.

But people matter too.

We want our managers spending time with customers and sales teams—coaching, teaching, solving problems, developing markets, and building relationships—not creating activity simply so another KPI can turn green.

We're part of the broader Meriton ecosystem, giving our teams access to capabilities and relationships beyond rental while still allowing us to operate with the speed, ownership, and entrepreneurial mindset our customers value.

If you're an experienced HVAC sales manager who misses being close to customers, enjoys developing people, understands the technical side of the business, and wants an opportunity to help build something—we'd like to talk with you.

Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship.

Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location.
