raw.title: Product Manager
raw.excerpt: DescriptionCapsLock builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry.
raw.description:
Description

CapsLock builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

﻿Role Overview

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

Responsibilities

﻿

﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

2. User Needs & Automation

  • Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
  • Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

3. Product Development & Delivery

  • Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
  • Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration

  • Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
  • Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

5. Experimentation & Optimization

  • Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
  • Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
  • Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
  • Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
  • Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. (Examples will be requested).
  • Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.

raw.description:
Why are you looking for a job?

If your answer ticks all the boxes, then maybe we can work together.

  • You have a curious mind - You won't understand what we're talking about if you don't.
  • You want to learn and try new things, even outside your comfort zone - You won't survive if you don't.
  • You like being precise - Even other people might hate you for that.
  • You want to make the world a bit better - We dont like you if you don't.

If you tick the above, then keep reading.

﻿

Squaredev?

We build great software! We use state-of-the-art technology to build solutions for our own customers and for the customers of our partners. We make sure we stay the best in class by contributing in research projects, where we collaborate with high-end partners across Europe.

Furthermore, we want to become a great company with the best team!

﻿

What you need to bring to the table

  • Learning attitude. We all have strong minds, as long as we work out the right muscles.
  • An impact in the company. You need to speak up. Loud. You are part of this.
  • Your failures. Yeah, you read it right. Everyone fails. Get used to it. Learn from it. Wear it as a badge.
  • A smile during our morning stand up.
    ﻿

Let's discuss the job

At Squaredev, we help organizations design, build and scale modern digital workflows using ServiceNow. We work closely with our clients to understand their business challenges and translate them into secure, scalable and efficient platform solutions.

We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Consultant who combines hands-on development skills with a strong consulting mindset. This role involves active participation in projects, close collaboration with clients and ownership of end-to-end ServiceNow solutions.

You will act as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation, contributing both to solution design and to high-quality development.

﻿

What's your responsibilities:

  • Design, configure and develop ServiceNow solutions aligned with client business processes.
  • Work closely with clients to understand their requirements, challenges and objectives through meetings and regular communication.
  • Translate business requirements into technical designs, leveraging ServiceNow out-of-the-box capabilities where possible.
  • Develop and customize ServiceNow applications, workflows and integrations using JavaScript and platform best practices.
  • Collaborate with distributed, cross-functional and international teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support solution architecture activities in cooperation with Technical Architects, ensuring alignment with enterprise systems.
  • Produce clear and structured documentation, including technical designs, configuration documentation and release notes.
  • Identify risks, constraints and technical issues early, communicating them proactively to the team.
  • Ensure solution quality, security, compliance with standards and data privacy requirements.
  • Contribute to workshops, demos and presentations, communicating technical concepts in a clear and business-oriented way.
  • Take ownership of your deliverables and working independently.
    ﻿

What you'll need:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in designing and implementing SaaS or enterprise platform solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow implementation and configuration.
  • Solid understanding of the software lifecycle and ServiceNow practices.
  • Experience working on complex IT projects or large-scale ServiceNow implementations.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to map business processes to platform capabilities.
  • Client-oriented mindset with the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Willingness to travel when project needs require it.
    ﻿

Nice to have (not required):

  • ServiceNow certifications (one or more of CSA, CAD, ITSM, HRSD, CSM, PPM, CAD etc.).
  • Experience with integrations and related technologies (REST, SOAP, APIs, JSON, XML).
  • Knowledge of authentication and security concepts (SSO, SAML, SSL).
  • Familiarity with relational databases (e.g. SQL, Oracle).
  • Front-end or scripting experience (JavaScript, HTML, CSS).
  • Awareness of cybersecurity and data protection considerations.
    ﻿﻿

How to apply?

Apply directly via this platform, and we will reach out to you!

﻿

Conclusion

Well that's it. Apply if you like our spirit! Also, feedback and questions are welcome. We want to become better and learn from you, whether you want to join or you're in the mood to help. Thanks for your time reading this. Looking forward to hearing from you.

raw.description:
About Nymbus

Nymbus is a high-growth fintech company, empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace. At Nymbus, we’re revolutionizing banking technology. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based solutions help financial institutions modernize, scale, and succeed. As part of our team, you won’t just be part of a tech revolution; you’ll be at the forefront of it, driving innovation and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and that takes people who are ready to challenge convention, move with purpose, and reimagine what’s possible. We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work, and the value we deliver to our clients.

We want our partners to be thrilled about the possibilities we are creating together and the lasting impact our collaboration will bring to the industry and consumers. The journey to growth begins with doing something different. And that journey starts with the great people who make Nymbus.

We challenge the status quo, question assumptions, and work together to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.

The Opportunity

The Digital Support Specialist provides front-line support to both consumer and business banking customers for our Launch clients. This role operates in a high-volume, fast-paced Contact Center environment and is responsible for delivering exceptional service through inbound phone calls, secure messages, chats, and other digital communication channels.

In addition to supporting retail banking customers, this role assists small business and commercial members with digital banking access, account servicing requests, and general business banking inquiries. The Digital Support Specialist is responsible for reviewing and processing customer applications submitted through retail and business account onboarding platforms, ensuring compliance with established policies, procedures, and Service Level Agreements.

This position requires strong decision-making skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to providing one-touch resolution whenever possible. Schedule flexibility is required to meet the needs of a 7-day-a-week Contact Center.

What You Will Own

Contact Center & Customer Support

  • Perform efficiently in a high-volume, production-driven Digital Call Center environment.
  • Answer inbound calls, secure messages, chats, and other communications from consumer and business banking customers.
  • Provide prompt, accurate, and professional service to ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Resolve customer issues on first contact whenever possible.
  • Perform account maintenance and servicing requests for both personal and business accounts.
  • Escalate complex or high-risk issues appropriately.

Business Banking Support

  • Assist small business and commercial customers with:
    • - Online and mobile banking access
    • - User access and password resets
    • - Basic ACH and wire inquiries
    • - Account balances and transaction research
    • - General business deposit account servicing
  • Support business account onboarding by reviewing submitted applications and documentation in accordance with policy and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable KYC, CIP, and BSA/AML guidelines when reviewing business customer information.

Risk, Compliance & Accuracy

  • Monitor retail and business digital bank applications and decision based on structured onboarding procedures.
  • Complete transactions accurately and within established guidelines and SLAs.
  • Exercise discretion and sound judgment while mitigating operational and fraud risk.
  • Identify and report system or client-impacting issues proactively.

Technical & Operational Support

  • Utilize multiple programs and systems to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve customer inquiries.
  • Document interactions clearly and accurately.
  • Participate in testing and validation of banking environments and system enhancements as assigned.

Professional Development

  • Participate in coaching and feedback sessions.
  • Engage in ongoing training to strengthen product knowledge, systems knowledge, and customer service skills.
  • Proactively seek opportunities to improve processes and service delivery.
  • Perform all other related duties as required or assigned.

Other duties as assigned

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Associate’s Degree or equivalent experience in a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in a financial institution, call center, or customer service role.
  • Experience supporting consumer and/or small business banking customers preferred.
  • Working knowledge of deposit accounts and basic business banking products.
  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Ability to multitask effectively in a multi-system environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet performance and SLA expectations.
  • Flexibility to work varied schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with KYC/CIP and banking compliance requirements preferred.

Internet Requirements

As a condition of employment, this role requires the candidate to maintain a stable, high-speed internet connection. Minimum upload speeds of 100 Mbps are required and must be sustained throughout employment.

How We Work

Nymbus is a remote-first company. Success in our remote environment requires self-motivation, initiative, and strong personal accountability. Team members are expected to manage their priorities independently, communicate proactively, remain responsive, and participate on camera during virtual meetings.

A strong remote culture requires intentional effort from everyone. We expect team members to engage in our global community, proactively build relationships, participate actively in team and company conversations, seek opportunities to collaborate, and take shared ownership of creating a connected and inclusive remote community including showing up on camera

Compensation and Benefits

  • Hourly pay: $23.00, with a premium for bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates.
  • Annual cash bonus and equity eligibility, if applicable.
  • Remote Work Environment
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, including HSA/FSA/DCA
  • 401(k) plan
  • Time-off and company holidays
  • Additional paid volunteer day
  • Supplemental Insurance Programs, including voluntary Life, Accident, Critical Illness, Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs [EAP]
  • Wellness programs
  • Growth and development programs

Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, role scope, and location.

Hiring at Nymbus

As an AI-first company, we embrace the power of AI tools throughout our hiring process. Nymbus remains committed to finding the right match for our teams and candidates alike. While we are excited about the AI tools available to us today, including AI-enabled video interview tools, we remain equally committed to maintaining human involvement and oversight throughout the hiring process.

Nymbus is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Nymbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process, including accommodations related to our use of AI tools. If you require an accommodation, please notify your recruiter.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the position is based. This role is currently based in the United States. Not all locations are available for consideration, and locations will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, this posting includes the anticipated base salary range, a general description of available benefits, and the application deadline where required. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and location.

By submitting this application, (i) you represent and warrant that you are not subject to or (ii) will disclose any non-compete agreement, restrictive covenant, or confidentiality obligation with a current or former employer that would restrict or prohibit you from performing the duties of the role for which you are applying.

Other

This is a hands-on role for someone who doesn't just experiment with AI, but has built, deployed, and optimized real AI systems in complex, production environments.

This role is for someone who takes full ownership of AI systems — from architecture to performance. You'll work at the intersection of LLMs, distributed data processing, and backend systems, building scalable AI pipelines and knowledge systems in a high-impact environment where performance, reliability, and flexibility (including airgapped deployments) matter.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and build distributed data pipelines (Apache Beam, Python) for large-scale document and model processing;
  • Implement horizontally scalable LLM-powered extraction workflows across thousands of entities;
  • Build runner-agnostic pipelines that run across multiple environments (local, cloud, on-prem);
  • Design and implement entity resolution and cross-referencing systems with confidence scoring;

Shining Star Consulting is seeking a Nonprofit Tax Manager to support our nonprofit clients with Federal Form 990 and various State compliance reporting. Compensation $55–$70/hour (SF Bay Area rate). Geographic adjustments apply for candidates outside the Bay Area.

Primary Duties:

1. Client Relationship Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients during the filing season.
  • Strengthen relationships with client leadership to position SSC as a trusted, long-term partner.
  • Maintain a high level of engagement during the tax preparation process.
  • Proactively identify client needs and collaborate to develop effective solutions to completing their filings.
  • Guide nonprofit boards and executive directors through the narrative sections of the 990 to ensure their "mission story" is told accurately.
  • Deliver high-quality 990 and related preparation and filing services to clients.
  • Resolve client issues and concerns in a timely and effective manner through constant communications.

2. 990 Preparation and Filings

  • Work with the Director of Compliance to set up the client engagement, including preparation of the engagement letter, schedule, information requests, and fees.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of IRS Form 990, 990-EZ, and 990-N filings and related State filings.
  • Collaborate with the client to obtain the information to timely file the Federal and State forms.
  • Review client financial statements (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, etc.) to accurately transpose data into tax software.
  • Prepare complex schedules, including Schedules A, B, D and O, and other schedules as needed, and ensure all disclosures meet IRS requirements.
  • Ensure the filing of the regulatory compliance forms meeting the schedule or deadlines.
  • Send our services invoice to the client and follow up on collections.

3. Other Filings

  • Support other nonprofit related compliance filings (e.g., 1023, 990-PF, 990-T, RRF-1, CA199 etc.)
  • Lead nonprofit dissolution compliance filings
  • Annual 1099 filings in January and beyond
  • Provide letters to Federal and State agencies regarding client fines and penalties, and other similar matters.

4. Regulatory Expertise

  • Maintain a deep, current understanding of IRS Form 990 instructions and changing tax laws affecting exempt organizations.
  • Monitor "red flag" areas such as unrelated business income (UBI), excess benefit transactions, and lobbying activities.

5. Tax and Compliance Resource

  • Provide nonprofit tax and compliance subject matter expertise to all of SSC
  • Respond to client queries regarding nonprofit regulatory compliance filings
  • Research specific state filing requirements
  • Help develop internal templates and workflows to improve filing efficiency

General responsibilities as a Shining Star employee will include:

  • Represent Shining Star: Lead by example of upholding our company values, meeting goals and contributing to our mission.
  • Participate, lead and learn: Lead and engage in individual and team training and meetings.
  • Communicate effectively: Respond to company communications promptly.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of tax compliance experience in Tax and Compliance, some of which must be in nonprofit returns.
  • Strong communication and organization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment involving many clients.
  • EA, or working towards certification
  • Proficiency in tax software and systems including MS Word and Excel

Preferred Qualifications

  • Nonprofit tax and accounting experience.
  • Degree in a relevant field (e.g., business administration, public administration, nonprofit management).
  • CPA or working towards certification, not required but helpful.
  • Proven track record of complete and timely compliance filings.

Necessary Skills

  • A passion for nonprofit work and a commitment to social impact.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills with a focus on building relationships. with clients and engaging the Tax and Compliance Team and across all of SSC.

Shining Star Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive pay rate of $55-$70 per hour, depending on experience and home location. Geographic adjustments apply for candidates outside the Bay Area.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance for full-time employees and some part-time employees.
  • Short-term disability, Long-term disability, and Life insurance for full-time employees only.
  • All employees have access to SIMPLE IRA retirement savings plan with employer contribution.
  • PTO at a competitive accrual rate.

Working at Shining Star:

The goal of Shining Star Consulting (SSC) is to provide accounting and finance area support to nonprofit organizations in order to help them successfully carry out their missions. We offer a range of services including financial leadership, clarity, efficiency, and knowledge of finances, ongoing accounting support as well as Grants Management and 990 Filing services. Over time, we will work with the client organization to get their accounting records up to date and ensure the financial information is reliable and timely, and we help implement systems and processes to make the accounting more efficient and effective.

The Shining Star Way - Why Our Employees Love Us!

  • High level of FLEXIBILITY! Our employees love the level of flexibility they are given with their work schedule and structure.
  • High level of AUTONOMY! Our employees love the opportunities we provide for them to grow and improve their skills with a perfect balance of support and autonomy.
  • Making an IMPACT! As a firm that works exclusively with nonprofits, you will be supporting organizations as they work to positively impact their communities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Our organization is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in all of our employment practices. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employment decisions at our organization are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to any protected status.

Nortek Data Center Cooling builds systems that keep modern data centers running — from liquid cooling to large scale air solutions. Our work supports some of the world’s most demanding AI and hyperscale environments, and we solve those challenges with engineering depth and practical execution.

We keep things simple here. We communicate early, stay close to the details, and follow through. When issues come up, we address them directly, not with layers of process. Customers count on us because we do what we say and we keep projects moving.

Our culture is hands on and collaborative. People take ownership, move quickly, and help each other. If you like working with teammates who are straightforward and accountable, you’ll feel at home.

With the backing of Madison Air, we have the scale, stability, and manufacturing footprint to support complex, high growth programs.

Position Summary

As our Field Service Technician – Data Center, you will work with warranty related service issues for our Datacenter product line. Provide service, guidance and technical expertise to end users and outside sales representatives.

Position Key Attributes

  • Commission, repair, and service mechanical and electrical equipment associated with new Data Center Cooling projects.

This requires working with multiple entities on a job – building owners, general and mechanical contractors, engineers, and local servicing contractors.

  • Consult with engineering and manufacturing personnel to resolve unusual problems in system operation and maintenance.

  • Provide superior customer service to both internal and external customers while maintaining a professional appearance and demeanor.

Position Qualifications

Requirements

Preferred

  • Trade/technical school or certification a plus

  • Product experience with industrial HVAC equipment or similar electromechanical products preferred

  • Strong experience in Microsoft Excel and Word

  • Intermediate experience with commercial projects

  • Building automation experience a plus

AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

A day in the life:

The primary responsibility of the Data Access Manager is to provide best-in-class support for prospective clients during Power Digital's sales cycle, guiding them through our Access & Integration process to ensure all necessary data sources are connected to our internal systems. This role is the connective tissue between our Revenue and Analyst teams during new business vetting—ensuring our Analysts have the platform access they need to deliver a complete and accurate marketing assessment.

The Data Access Manager builds trust quickly with prospective clients through clear communication, high emotional intelligence, and a consistently positive experience. They are an effective English speaker who can calmly and confidently guide clients through technical access requirements, maintaining a professional and solutions-oriented attitude throughout. Platform-specific expertise can be learned on the job—the ability to build rapport, problem-solve access challenges, and represent the Power Digital brand well is what matters most.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for prospective clients during the data access and integration phase of the sales cycle
  • Partner closely with the Revenue and Analyst teams to coordinate platform access ahead of and during marketing audits
  • Manage prospective client onboarding environments
  • Maintain and evolve the library of Access & Integration materials
  • Regularly update internal documentation as platform access processes change over time
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize Access & Integration processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • Training and Onboarding Expertise: Experience guiding clients or customers through onboarding processes and conducting effective training sessions
  • Problem-Solving Experience: Background in addressing and resolving customer issues, ideally in a technical or software-related context
  • Analytical and Reporting Skills: Familiarity with using analytics tools for customer data analysis and reporting
  • Experience using Google Sheets for administrative tasks
  • Familiarity with the access protocol for the following platforms a plus:
    • Google Analytics
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads
    • TikTok Ads
    • Pinterest Ads
    • HubSpot, Salesforce, and similar CRMs
    • Klaviyo & similar ESPs
    • Shopify & similar CDPs
  • Familiarity with marketing and financial KPIs is a plus

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Access Request Velocity: Decrease avg. days to complete access requests (OKR = 7 days or less)
  • First-Touch Completeness Rate: % of appraisals where no follow-up access requests were needed after the initial outreach.
  • Integration Completion Rate: % of available integrations completed once access is granted (OKR = 100%)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Access Request Velocity
  • Completed Integrations
  • Access & Integration Success

MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As a product-focused Senior Frontend Developer on our AI track, you'll own frontend delivery end-to-end for products that directly affect how patients access mental health care and how our clinicians and staff work day-to-day. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release.

﻿Why this role:

  • Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how.
  • Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond).

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release.
  • Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine.
  • Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements.
  • Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself.
  • Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community.

﻿This role is not for you if:

  • You're waiting for someone else to define what to build,we expect you to come up with ideas, take them through discovery and development, ship them, and own the results after launch.
  • You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you
  • You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred).
  • Experience owning a product end-to-end, including analysing the metrics that tell you whether it actually worked.
  • Strong product and UX judgment, you can recognize when an interaction doesn't feel right and propose a better solution.
  • Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework.
  • Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively.
  • Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian.
  • Full overlap with CET working hours.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features.
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes.
  • Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

﻿Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

raw.title: Director, Cloud Platform Engineering
raw.excerpt: We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families.
raw.description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

Enterprise Technology plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are.

In this position...

Ford is seeking a visionary Director, Cloud Platform Engineering – Data, Analytics & Agentic Data Cloud to own strategy, architecture, and engineering of Ford's cloud database and analytics platforms — built on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services including Cloud SQL, Spanner, AlloyDB, BigTable, Firestore, and BigQuery. This leader will bring a product-minded, automation-first, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) platform engineering discipline to every layer of Ford's data estate, own Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) and fit-for-purpose database architecture patterns for Product Development Organizations (PDO), drive consolidation and cost optimization of SaaS database products, and define Ford's Agentic Data Cloud patterns — including database MCP servers, Knowledge Catalog, and Conversational Analytics — for consumption by application teams.

What you'll do...

Platform Engineering Vision & Leadership

  • Serve as Ford's visionary platform engineering leader for cloud databases and analytics — setting a multi-year strategic roadmap that anticipates future AI, security, and scale requirements.
  • Instill a platform engineering mindset across the data estate — treating databases and analytics systems as internal products with self-service APIs, golden paths, paved roads, and clear SLOs rather than ticket-driven infrastructure.
  • Drive all platform services through an Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) mindset — defining, provisioning, and managing database and analytics infrastructure as version-controlled, testable, and repeatable code rather than manual configuration.
  • Continue to deepen partnerships with cloud and SaaS vendors, co-building rich, differentiated capabilities within their platforms so Ford operates as a strategic technical partner rather than a passive consumer.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a global, high-performing team of platform engineers, architects, and SREs; foster a culture of innovation through hackathons, ideathons, and DevSecOps community events.

Cloud Database & Analytics Platform Engineering

  • Architect and operate GCP-native database platforms (Cloud SQL, Spanner, AlloyDB, BigTable, Firestore) with consistent, reusable, IaC-driven platform engineering patterns across provisioning, security, and observability.
  • Own platform engineering for BigQuery and the broader analytics stack — building governed, self-service data pipelines and reusable analytics tooling for product and data science teams.
  • Build golden-path templates, service APIs, and IaC-based paved-road automation that let engineering teams provision and operate database and analytics resources safely and consistently at scale.

Database-as-a-Service & Fit-for-Purpose Architecture

  • Own Ford's Cloud Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) strategy, enabling self-service provisioning across GCP-native and SaaS database platforms with automated, golden-path IaC pipelines.
  • Define and evangelize database architecture patterns that guide Product Development Organizations (PDO) toward fit-for-purpose database selection — matching workload characteristics to the right relational, NoSQL, graph, or in-memory technology rather than defaulting to a single platform.
  • Partner with PDO application and engineering teams to embed these architecture patterns into design reviews, reference architectures, and reusable templates.
  • SaaS Consolidation & Cost Optimization
  • Lead enterprise-wide consolidation of SaaS database products (e.g., MongoDB, Neo4J, Redis), reducing platform sprawl, redundant licensing, and support overhead.
  • Own full lifecycle management of database, analytics, and SaaS platforms — versioning, patching, upgrade planning, end-of-life tracking, and decommissioning of unused resources — to proactively eliminate unnecessary and duplicate cost.
  • Own full lifecycle management of database, analytics, and SaaS platforms — versioning, patching, upgrade planning, end-of-life tracking, and decommissioning of unused resources — to proactively eliminate unnecessary and duplicate cost.
  • Own cost-optimization strategy and cloud-cost mindsets (rightsizing, usage governance, cost recommenders) across the data platform portfolio; manage vendor contracts and negotiate enterprise agreements.

Agentic Data Cloud

  • Define and evangelize Ford's Agentic Data Cloud strategy, shifting the enterprise from a passive system of intelligence to an agent-centric system of action.
  • Provide application teams with standardized, reusable patterns for database MCP (Model Context Protocol) Servers, enabling AI agents to safely discover, reason over, and act on enterprise data.
  • Lead deployment of Knowledge Catalog capabilities for AI-context governance and data discoverability, and roll out Conversational Analytics patterns for natural-language data interaction across Ford's applications.
  • Define guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls aligned to Ford's Agentic AI Rubric; partner with Google product and engineering teams (GDIA, Enterprise Architecture) on POC design and service launch frameworks.

You'll have...

  • 15+ years in software engineering, cloud architecture, and data platform services, including significant leadership experience.
  • Proven platform engineering ownership of large-scale database and analytics environments on GCP (Cloud SQL, Spanner, AlloyDB, BigTable, Firestore, BigQuery).
  • Strong hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tooling and practices, driving platform services through code-defined, version-controlled automation rather than manual provisioning.
  • Direct experience with SaaS database platforms (MongoDB, Neo4J, Elastic, Redis), including consolidation and cost-optimization initiatives at enterprise scale.
  • Demonstrated success owning DBaaS and defining fit-for-purpose database architecture patterns adopted by application/product teams.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic AI and data platform concepts — MCP servers, Knowledge Catalog, Conversational Analytics, and AI governance frameworks.
  • Strong background in DevOps/SRE practices, automation, CI/CD, and observability.
  • Bachelor's degree required

Even better, you may have...

  • Excellent executive communication skills and ability to lead through influence;
  • Master's degree preferred

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
  • Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  • Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
  • Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
  • Tuition assistance
  • Established and active employee resource groups
  • Paid time off for individual and team community service
  • A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day

  • Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is leadership level 5 and ranges from $141,700-$268,300.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.

*Internal applicants: moving into this role may result in an adjustment to your current compensation based on the posted pay range for this role, taking into consideration your qualifications and other relevant factors.

For more information on salary and benefits, click here: New Hire Benefits

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1-888-336-0660.

raw.description:
Grasshopper Bank is a client-first, digital bank built for the business and innovation economy, with an obsession for providing leading-edge technology, solutions-driven products and superior service through a combination of passionate people and digital resources.
We are a highly experienced team who pride ourselves on diversity of thought and perspective. Nationally chartered, our portfolio of products and services range from VC, PE & Portfolio Companies to SBA Lending, as well as direct SMB and Embedded Banking.
Our entrepreneurial drive allows us to support the growth and success of a wide range of clients at every stage of their business through inclusive partnership. We seek out team members who will enable both our organization and our people to grow and thrive through collaboration and acting with integrity and respect.
Our focus on cross-functional teamwork provides a culture where ideas are valued, accountability is encouraged, and successes are celebrated. We welcome all those searching for the opportunity to contribute to banking innovation that influences and supports the emerging digital world of Financial Services.
Our digital first approach enables our teams the flexibility to work remotely. We have offices in NYC and Boston.

What you'll do:

Reporting into the Director of Fintech Risk, we are seeking a motivated Fintech Risk Analyst who will contribute to and support a strong risk management culture in working with existing and prospective Fintech partners and business leaders across the organization. This role sits in the second line of defense and is responsible for supporting the adherence and execution of risk pillars across the Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) portfolio while understanding the competitive landscape of the fintech industry in a regulated Bank environment.
Responsibilities include:
  • Serve as an individual contributor across the Bank’s BaaS portfolio to effectively identify, manage, and remediate risks
  • Ongoing collaboration with various teams, including BSA, Embedded Finance, Operations, and Product, and external third party banking technology platforms
  • Perform due diligence risk assessment on prospective fintech partners to assess inherent risk, control effectiveness, and residual risks associated with partnership. Present risk assessment results to senior management for review and approval prior to onboarding
  • Track pre and post-launch risk and compliance requirements for newly onboarded partners
  • Conduct ongoing testing, monitoring, and quality assurance activities for onboarded partners to ensure adherence to Bank policy and regulatory requirements. Track identified issues to remediation
  • Serve as primary risk/compliance contact for specific fintech partners, offering expert advice and direction to ensure their programs comply with applicable regulations and align to Bank requirements, especially those related to financial crimes (BSA/AML, OFAC, fraud) and regulatory compliance (account opening, account maintenance and disclosures, bank statements, funds availability, etc.)
  • Support the maintenance of a prioritized roadmap to address gaps and improve control design and testing practices
  • Participate in relevant team and cross-functional meetings as required

What you need:

  • At least 3-5 years of experience in banking or fintech risk management and compliance
  • Demonstrated experience with financial crimes compliance (BSA/AML, OFAC watchlists and sanctions)
  • Working knowledge across essential banking compliance areas, including UDAAP, payment network rules (NACHA, VISA/Mastercard, FedNow/TCH RTP), core commercial or consumer compliance regulations (e.g., Reg E, Reg Z, Reg DD, Reg CC, ECOA, FCRA), and/or data privacy regulations (GLBA, FCRA, state laws)
  • Experience in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) and related interagency guidance (e.g., OCC, FDIC, FRB)
  • Proficient technical knowledge in financial technology and payments is preferred
  • Strong critical thinking traits, including analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
  • Ability to develop and maintain reporting, dashboards and presentations preferred
  • Strong team orientation and ability to collaborate effectively
  • Ability to think outside of the box to develop creative solutions to emerging problems
  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience

raw.description:
(Senior) AI Platform Engineer (m/f/d)

Buscamos un perfil (Senior) AI Platform Engineer con experiencia para diseñar, Implementar y mejorar plataformas modernas, escalables y orientadas a IA y Machine Learning. Trabajarás con Kubernetes, infraestructuras GPU, automatización e Infraestructura como Código (IaC), así como con procesos modernos de CI/CD y MLOps, tanto en entornos on-premises como en la nube.

Te esperan proyectos variados para clientes de múltiples sectores y un equipo comprometido y apasionado por construir la próxima generación de soluciones de inteligencia artificial. Si deseas aportar tu experiencia a proyectos innovadores, ¡esperamos tu candidatura!

Quiénes somos

evoila es un líder europeo especializado en Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Native, Data & AI y App Modernization, con un fuerte crecimiento en España. Colaboramos con empresas medianas y grandes para diseñar y construir infraestructuras cloud modernas, escalables y seguras.

Somos partners reconocidos de VMware, Microsoft y otros líderes del sector. ¿Nuestro enfoque? Nada de palabrería—solo competencia y resultados.

En evoila, te esperan proyectos emocionantes, donde desarrollarás e implementarás soluciones innovadoras para clientes de diversas industrias.

Tus responsabilidades

  • Diseñar, implementar y operar plataformas y servicios de IA/ML altamente disponibles, principalmente sobre Kubernetes, en entornos on-premises, híbridos y cloud.
  • Diseñar e implementar infraestructuras GPU escalables en clústeres Kubernetes, incluyendo mecanismos avanzados de programación y compartición de GPU (por ejemplo: Kueue, KAI Scheduler, Run:ai, NVIDIA MIG o time-slicing), con especial atención a la optimización de costes y recursos.
  • Implementar y mantener servicios de inferencia y despliegue de modelos (por ejemplo: vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, KServe, NVIDIA NIM o Ray), tanto para modelos tradicionales de Machine Learning como para Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Desarrollar y operar procesos de MLOps y LLMOps para servicios de IA Generativa en producción, incluyendo controles de seguridad (guardrails), políticas, evaluación de modelos, pruebas de regresión y monitorización de calidad y costes.
  • Implementar procesos de fine-tuning y reentrenamiento continuo de modelos (por ejemplo, LoRA y aprendizaje continuo).
  • Monitorizar, diagnosticar y optimizar plataformas de IA, incluyendo métricas como utilización de GPU, latencia de inferencia y throughput, garantizando el máximo rendimiento y disponibilidad.
  • Asesorar a nuestros clientes sobre mejores prácticas, gobierno de IA, seguridad y protección de datos en plataformas basadas en Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de Data Science, plataformas de datos y desarrollo para garantizar la integración eficiente de soluciones de IA.

Qué buscamos

  • Mínimo 3 años de experiencia operando y optimizando plataformas y servicios a gran escala sobre Kubernetes, tanto en entornos cloud como on-premises.
  • Conocimientos sólidos en diseño y operación de soluciones escalables basadas en Kubernetes, idealmente incluyendo cargas de trabajo con GPU.
  • Experiencia en programación con Python; se valorarán conocimientos de Golang o Java.
  • Experiencia con al menos un framework de serving de modelos (como vLLM, NVIDIA Triton o KServe) y conocimientos prácticos de herramientas MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow, ClearML u otras).
  • Experiencia con herramientas de Infraestructura como Código como Terraform y Ansible, así como con herramientas de CI/CD y GitOps (Argo CD, Flux, entre otras).
  • Capacidad para interactuar con clientes y explicar conceptos técnicos tanto a equipos de ingeniería como a perfiles de dirección.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación en español e inglés.
  • No se aceptarán candidaturas en modalidad remota desde otros países. Es imprescindible residir en España.

Requisitos adicionales para el nivel Senior

  • Más de 5 años de experiencia relevante en Platform Engineering.
  • Responsabilidad sobre el diseño integral de arquitecturas de plataformas de IA y toma de decisiones tecnológicas clave.
  • Liderazgo técnico en proyectos con clientes y experiencia en mentoría y acompañamiento de otros profesionales.

Se valorará positivamente

  • Experiencia con servicios de IA en la nube como AWS SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry y su integración con Kubernetes.
  • Experiencia en arquitecturas basadas en LLM, incluyendo:
    • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
    • Bases de datos vectoriales
    • Servicios de embeddings
    • Sistemas Agentic AI
    • Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Conocimientos sobre aspectos de infraestructura de modelos LLM como Rate limiting, Token streaming, Balanceo de carga, Prompt templates, Tool calling, Modelos con capacidades de razonamiento
  • Experiencia con componentes emergentes de inferencia como llm-d, Kubernetes Inference Gateway
  • Conocimientos en seguridad de plataformas de IA: TLS, RBAC, Network Policies, Gobierno de IA y cumplimiento normativo (incluyendo el Reglamento Europeo de IA - EU AI Act)
  • Certificaciones relevantes, como:
    • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
    • Certified Kubernetes Developer (CKAD)
    • Certificaciones NVIDIA
  • Disponibilidad para realizar viajes puntuales en España o Europa según necesidades de los clientes y proyectos asignados

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Participación en proyectos innovadores de IA, Machine Learning y Cloud Native.
  • Trabajo con tecnologías punteras y arquitecturas de última generación.
  • Desarrollo profesional continuo y acceso a formación especializada.
  • Un entorno colaborativo, internacional y orientado al aprendizaje.
  • Flexibilidad y autonomía dentro de una compañía europea en pleno crecimiento.

¿Te apasiona construir las plataformas que impulsarán la próxima generación de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial? Entonces queremos conocerte.

En evoila, la formación intensiva y el desarrollo profesional no son solo palabras en papel, sino una realidad para todos nuestros empleados.

Si quieres trabajar en proyectos reales, con profesionales competentes, en un entorno sin burocracia, únete a nuestro equipo y da forma al futuro de la nube.


(Senior) AI Platform Engineer (m/f/d)

We are looking for an experienced (Senior) AI Platform Engineer (m/f/d) to design, run and keep improving modern, scalable AI and ML platforms. You will work with Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, automation and Infrastructure-as-Code, along with modern CI/CD and MLOps processes, both on-premises and in the cloud. You can expect varied customer projects across many industries and a committed team that is passionate about building the next generation of AI solutions. If you want to bring your expertise to innovative projects, we look forward to your application!

Who We Are

evoila is an European leader specializing in Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Native, Data & AI, and App Modernisation, with a strong growth in Spain. We collaborate with medium and large enterprises to design and build modern, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructures.

We are recognized partners of VMware, Microsoft, and other industry leaders. Our approach? No fluff—just expertise and impact.

At evoila, exciting projects await you, where you will develop and implement innovative solutions for customers across various industries.

Your responsibilities

  • Plan, build and run highly available AI/ML platforms and services, mainly on Kubernetes, in on-premises, hybrid and cloud environments.
  • Design and implement scalable GPU infrastructure in Kubernetes clusters, including GPU scheduling and sharing (e.g. Kueue, KAI Scheduler, Run:ai, NVIDIA MIG/time-slicing), with a focus on utilization and cost efficiency.
  • Build and run model-serving and inference services (e.g. vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, KServe, NVIDIA NIM, Ray) for classic ML models and large language models.
  • Develop and run MLOps/LLMOps workflows for GenAI services in production, including guardrails and policies, evaluation, regression testing, and cost and quality monitoring.
  • Provide fine-tuning and re-training workflows (e.g. LoRA, continuous re-training) on the platform.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot and tune AI platforms (e.g. GPU utilization, inference latency, throughput) to keep performance and availability as high as possible.
  • Advise our customers on best practices, AI governance, data security and data protection for AI platforms on Kubernetes.
  • Work closely with data science, data platform and development teams so that AI solutions integrate smoothly.

What you bring

  • At least 3 years of experience running and optimizing platforms and services at scale in Kubernetes environments, on-premises or in the cloud.
  • In-depth knowledge of designing and running scalable Kubernetes-based solutions, ideally including GPU workloads.
  • Programming skills in Python, ideally also Golang or Java.
  • Experience with at least one model-serving framework (e.g. vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, KServe), and some or extensive experience with MLOps tools (e.g. MLflow, Kubeflow, ClearML).
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Ansible and Terraform, and with CI/CD and GitOps tools (e.g. Argo CD, Flux).
  • Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English. Ideally, you have advised customers before and can explain technical topics to any audience, from engineering teams to management.
  • NO remote position from other countries, candidates should be based in Spain.

Additionally for the senior role

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in platform engineering.
  • Architecture ownership: you are responsible for designing AI platforms end-to-end and make the core technology decisions.
  • Technical leadership in customer projects (lead role) and mentoring of colleagues.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud AI services (e.g. AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure ML/Azure OpenAI/Azure AI Foundry) and integrating them with Kubernetes workloads.
  • Knowledge of running LLM-based architectures, e.g. RAG pipelines, vector databases and embedding services, as well as agentic AI approaches and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Understanding of the system-level basics of LLM serving (rate limiting, token streaming, load balancing) and of LLM concepts such as reasoning, tool calling and prompt templates.
  • Experience with new serving components such as llm-d or the Kubernetes Inference Gateway.
  • Knowledge of securing AI platforms, e.g. TLS, RBAC and network policies in Kubernetes environments, and a basic understanding of AI governance (e.g. the EU AI Act).
  • Certifications in relevant technologies (e.g. Certified Kubernetes Administrator/Developer, NVIDIA certifications).
  • Willingness to travel occasionally in Spain or across Europe.

Intensive onboarding and regular training are not just on paper for us but are a given for all our employees.

If you want to work on real projects, with competent professionals, in a non-bureaucratic environment, join our team and be part of the change.

OneOcean is a unified brand born from the integration of OneOcean and Ocean Technologies Group.
Owned by Lloyd’s Register, an organisation with more than 260 years of trust, integrity and leadership at sea, OneOcean combines the agility and ambition of a fast-moving innovator with the strength and stability of one of the world’s most trusted maritime institutions.
At the heart of OneOcean is a portfolio unlike any other in maritime. A comprehensive, integrated portfolio built on years of expertise, trusted by thousands of maritime professionals around the world.
🎯 Our Mission: Our mission is clear. In the race to zero emissions, our research, advisory and technical expertise and industry-firsts are supporting a safe, sustainable maritime energy transition. Today we are a leading provider of classification and compliance services to the marine and offshore industries, helping our clients design, construct and operate their assets to accepted levels of safety and environmental compliance.

🔍 Why Join OneOcean Crew?
Legacy & Innovation: We were created more than 260 years ago as the world’s first marine classification society to improve and set standards for the safety of ships.
Global Impact: Our digital solutions are relied upon by more than 30,000 vessels, following the acquisition of OneOcean in 2022 and Ocean Technologies Group in 2024.
Product Offering: Covering five proven product areas - learning, fleet operations, compliance, voyage planning and performance management - supporting its customers from ship to shore, from training and people operations, to voyage compliance and optimisation.
🧭 Navigating the position: Product Manager
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner with a maritime industry background and extensive knowledge of the TM Master product. This role is critical to ensuring that the TM Master product evolves in line with the complex operational needs of modern shipping companies.
You will take responsibility for key TM Master Modules and act as the bridge between stakeholders, customers, and engineering teams—owning the product backlog for those modules.

Working with the Senior Product Manager, you will collaborate in shaping product strategy, defining priorities, and delivering high-impact features that improve operational efficiency, compliance, safety and vessel performance.
We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about the problems maritime operators face, rigorous about how they make decisions, and comfortable working with ambiguity

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Delivery
  • Own and manage the TM Master product backlog, ensuring clear prioritisation aligned with business goals
  • Translate product strategy into actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Work closely with engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver high-quality releases
  • Drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and review sessions

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Collaborate with maritime customers (ship managers, superintendents, crew) to gather insights and validate requirements
  • Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring solutions address real operational challenges onboard and ashore

Product Strategy & Roadmap
  • Contribute to and execute the product roadmap for TM Master
  • Identify opportunities for innovation in maintenance, compliance, procurement, and vessel performance
  • Balance short-term delivery with long-term product vision

Domain Expertise & Compliance
  • Leverage knowledge of maritime operations (planned maintenance systems, safety, compliance)
  • Ensure product alignment with industry regulations (e.g., ISM, class requirements, audits)
  • Stay informed on trends in digital shipping, IoT, and fleet optimisation

Data & Continuous Improvement
  • Define and track product KPIs (adoption, performance, customer satisfaction)
  • Use data and user feedback to iterate and improve features
  • Champion continuous improvement and product excellence

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise


Product Ownership & Delivery
  • 5+ years experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in a B2B environment
  • Strong track record of working in Agile/Scrum teams and delivering complex software products at scale
  • Proven ability to manage and prioritise large, complex backlogs
Maritime Domain Expertise
  • Solid experience within the maritime industry
  • Extensive knowledge of Planned Maintenance Systems (PMS) and associated operational workflows, in particular TM Master.
  • Strong understanding of vessel operations, compliance, and maintenance practices
TM Master / Product Knowledge
  • Extensive hands-on knowledge of the TMv2 product and its modules, data structures, and workflows

Technical & Analytical Skills
  • Competent in using SQL Manager and writing queries for data analysis and validation

  • Strong ability to present user workflows, concepts, and solutions clearly to stakeholders and customers

Preferred Experience (Highly Desirable)

Partnering with an AE, you own technical leadership, value articulation, and de-risking security/integration, building alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees.

Insight-led discovery and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing, introduce a sharper point of view on where value is actually trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls), and reframe urgency using cost-of-inaction.

  • Lead discovery across CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate that into a crisp target-state narrative and mutual action plan.

Solution design and technical leadership

  • Architect a tailored solution: scope, rollout approach, integration pattern, security posture, and success criteria.

  • Run deep dives with IT/security and articulate how blp works in enterprise environments (ERP digital twin, data synchronization, governance and controls).

Demos, workshops, and executive storytelling

  • Deliver high-impact demos that map to customer workflows (P2P, AP, S2P) and prove outcomes, not features.

  • Facilitate workshops that turn stakeholder skepticism into a tangible blueprint and path to value.

Value engineering (business case support)

  • Build a credible value narrative: labor productivity gains, cycle time reduction, compliance/control improvements, and stack simplification.

  • Support champions and the AE with executive-ready business-case inputs, impact ranges, and rollout economics, flagging risk to the deal early rather than late.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Help the deal team land a clear "why now" anchored in operational risk, ERP program success, and enterprise scale requirements.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 3–8+ years in Value Engineering / Presales / Solution Consulting / ERP process consulting (or equivalent in finance/procurement operations with strong customer-facing chops).

  • Demonstrated ability to run insight-based discovery (Challenger-style): you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and build conviction across a buying committee.

  • Comfort with senior stakeholders (CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services): you can lead without authority.

  • Strong workshop facilitation and demo craft: story, structure, and objection handling.

  • Ability to connect technical realities to business outcomes (FTE capacity, cycle time, controls, compliance risk, TCO).

Strong plus

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

  • Finance/process knowledge: AP, invoice processing, S2P/P2P, exception handling, approvals, master data workflows.

  • Experience competing against legacy vendors and "patchwork stacks."

Language

  • Fluent in English and another major European language, preferably German, depending on territory.

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

raw.description:
Senior Finance Manager

Position Summary

The Senior Finance Manager is a strategic member of the Finance team responsible for financial planning and analysis, budgeting, accounting, federal grant financial management, compliance, and executive financial reporting for the Epilepsy Foundation of America. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, this position partners closely with executive leadership and department leaders to support informed decision-making, strengthen organizational financial performance, and ensure compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), federal regulations, nonprofit accounting standards, and organizational policies.

This role requires an experienced nonprofit finance professional with expertise in financial planning and analysis, fund accounting, federal grant administration, budgeting, forecasting, and executive reporting. The ideal candidate possesses advanced proficiency in Sage Intacct, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to translate complex financial information into meaningful insights that support organizational strategy.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Financial Planning, Budgeting, and Analysis

  • Lead the organization's annual operating budget process and coordinate budget development across all departments.
  • Prepare annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, long-range financial projections, and financial models that support strategic planning and organizational decision-making.
  • Produce monthly budget-to-actual reports, including variance analyses, trend reporting, and actionable recommendations.
  • Develop financial dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and executive reporting tools to monitor organizational performance.
  • Prepare financial reporting packages and presentations for executive leadership, the Finance Committee, and the Board of Directors.
  • Perform financial modeling, forecasting, scenario planning, and ad hoc analyses to support strategic initiatives.

Accounting and Financial Management

  • Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process, including journal entries, reconciliations, and financial statement preparation.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP, nonprofit accounting standards, and internal financial policies.
  • Oversee the billing and revenue recognition function, including supervision of one direct report.
  • Monitor restricted and unrestricted net assets and ensure proper accounting for donor-imposed restrictions.
  • Manage revenue recognition for grants, contributions, contracts, bequests, investment activity, and special events.
  • Reconcile investment activity and prepare related journal entries.
  • Maintain effective internal controls while identifying opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency.

Federal Grants and Compliance

  • Manage the financial administration of federal grants, cooperative agreements, and government contracts throughout the grant lifecycle.
  • Prepare grant drawdown documentation for management review and approval.
  • Prepare and submit required federal financial reports, including SF-425 reports and other sponsor reporting requirements.
  • Monitor grant budgets, allowable costs, indirect cost recovery, carryforward balances, and budget modifications.
  • Prepare annual Incurred Cost Submissions (ICS), indirect cost calculations, and supporting schedules.
  • Coordinate grant closeouts, subrecipient monitoring, and ongoing compliance activities.
  • Ensure compliance with Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), sponsor requirements, and organizational policies.
  • Prepare supporting documentation for Single Audits, external audits, and other grant compliance reviews.

Leadership and Collaboration

  • Serve as a trusted financial advisor to executive leadership and department managers.
  • Partner with Finance, Development, Programs, Human Resources, and Operations to support organizational priorities and strategic initiatives.
  • Supervise, coach, and develop assigned finance staff while promoting accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements that strengthen financial operations, internal controls, and reporting capabilities.
  • Participate in cross-functional strategic initiatives and perform other duties as assigned.

Expected Deliverables

  • Lead the successful development and execution of the organization's annual operating budget.
  • Deliver accurate and timely monthly financial reporting, variance analyses, and executive dashboards.
  • Produce quarterly forecasts and long-range financial projections that support strategic planning.
  • Ensure accurate accounting and compliance with GAAP, nonprofit accounting standards, and internal controls.
  • Successfully manage federal grant financial administration, reporting, and compliance requirements.
  • Prepare accurate Board of Directors and Finance Committee financial reporting materials.
  • Support successful Single Audits and external audits through timely preparation of financial documentation.
  • Strengthen financial reporting processes through continuous improvement and operational efficiencies.

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required.

CPA and/or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration preferred.

Experience Requirements

  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible accounting and finance experience, including at least five years within a nonprofit 501(c)(3) organization.
  • Demonstrated expertise in financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and executive financial reporting.
  • Significant experience managing federal grants and cooperative agreements, including Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), SF-425 reporting, indirect cost recovery, and Incurred Cost Submissions.
  • Experience preparing financial reports and presentations for executive leadership, Finance Committees, and Boards of Directors.
  • Advanced experience using Sage Intacct and Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience supervising finance staff and leading cross-functional financial initiatives preferred.

Technical Skills and Competencies

  • Thorough knowledge of GAAP, nonprofit accounting principles, and fund accounting.
  • Strong understanding of restricted and unrestricted net asset accounting.
  • Extensive knowledge of federal grant regulations, indirect cost methodologies, Single Audits, and grant compliance requirements.
  • Advanced proficiency in Sage Intacct, including financial reporting, dimensions, budgeting, dashboards, and financial analytics.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Exceptional analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex financial information to executive leadership and the Board of Directors.
  • Strong leadership, relationship-building, and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines in a collaborative, mission-driven environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position supervises one Finance team member and is responsible for coaching, performance management, professional development, and oversight of assigned financial functions.

Work Environment and Travel

This is a full-time (35 hours/week), remote position. Occasional travel may be required for organizational meetings, training, conferences, or Board-related activities.
