raw.description:
About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to provide technical leadership on Coalition’s Scanning Engine & Data Collection team. This team is responsible for the distributed systems that continuously scan the internet and our customers’ environments to collect the security data that powers our cyber insurance underwriting and our attack surface management product, Coalition Control.

In this role, you will design, build, and operate large-scale cloud services that run internet-wide and customer-specific scans, ingest and normalize third-party threat intelligence, and surface high-quality findings into our underwriting, risk, and security workflows. You’ll work closely with other senior engineers, security, product, and data teams to evolve the architecture of our scanning platform, improve its performance and reliability, and help mentor engineers across a distributed team spanning the US, Canada, and EU.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end systems design for key components of the scanning engine, from initial design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing iteration
  • Design and implement high-quality services in Python and Go that power our scanning workflows, ensuring code is maintainable, well-tested, and observable.
  • Improve performance, scalability, and reliability of the scanning engine, optimizing for large-scale, distributed scanning workloads and strict SLAs.
  • Partner with security, product, and data teams to translate detection and scanning requirements into robust, production-ready systems and APIs.
  • Drive technical excellence and standards in the scanning engine codebase, including code review rigor, design documentation, and best practices for secure coding.
  • Contribute to architecture and roadmap decisions for the scanning platform, evaluating tradeoffs and proposing solutions that balance speed, quality, and risk.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex production issues related to scanning performance, accuracy, and stability, collaborating with SRE/Infra teams where needed.
  • Mentor and support other engineers on the team through design feedback, pairing, and knowledge sharing around systems design and scanning domain concepts.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a Senior Software Engineer (or equivalent) working on backend or systems-level services.
  • Proficiency in at least one of Python or Go, with the ability and willingness to work in both languages over time.
  • Demonstrated experience with systems design for distributed or high-availability services, including clear understanding of scalability, reliability, and observability.
  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining scanning, detection, or similar engine-like systems (e.g., vulnerability scanning, security scanning, data processing pipelines, or similar high-throughput engines).
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and performance optimization.
  • Experience working in a cloud-native environment (e.g., microservices, containers, CI/CD, monitoring, logging).
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, including product, security, and platform/infra, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of owning projects end-to-end, from problem definition and design through implementation, rollout, and iteration.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment, making pragmatic technical decisions while maintaining quality and security.
  • Experience with code quality practices (testing, static analysis, code reviews) and building maintainable systems.

Bonus Points

  • Cyber security domain knowledge in scanning through endpoints.

Compensation

As a remote-first organization, our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several Canadian geographic markets.

In Alberta, British Columbia & Ontario the base salary for this position ranges from $149,600/year up to $199,600/year.

For all other locations, the base salary for this position ranges from $134,600/year up to $184,600/year.

Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your Recruiter can share more on the specific target salary range for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Use of AI: We utilize AI-assisted tools to help us organize and review the high volume of applications we receive. However, our human recruiting team makes all final hiring decisions and interview selections, valuing personal connection over algorithms.

Application Updates: Consistent with our commitment to transparency, if you are interviewed for this role, we will provide a status update on your application within 45 days of your final interview.

Perks

  • 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible PTO
  • Annual home office stipend and WeWork access
  • Mental & physical health wellness programs like Headspace, Lumino, and more!
  • Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

Visit our Newsroom >

Privacy Notice

Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. We collect, use, and store personal information as necessary for the recruitment process and in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations in all regions where we operate. We want you to understand what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding access, correction, and deletion of your data where applicable. Information submitted, collected, and processed as part of your application is subject to Coalition's Privacy Policy. For further details, please review our full Privacy Policy or contact us with any questions regarding how your information is handled.

Our Privacy Policy >

Safe Hiring Notice

All legitimate communication from Coalition comes from @coalitioninc.com emails, and open roles are listed only on our Careers page. We never ask for payment, banking details, or personal identification before an offer is accepted through our secure systems. If you believe you’ve been a victim of fraudulent recruiting, follow guidance from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC).

Anti-Discrimination Notice

Coalition is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable laws in each country where we operate. This commitment includes, but is not limited to, ensuring equal treatment in recruitment, selection, training, promotion, transfer, compensation, and all other aspects of employment. Coalition does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace.

Accommodations

Coalition is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, including applicants and employees, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in each country where we operate. Our policy is to support equal opportunity in the hiring process by considering qualified applicants regardless of disability or other protected characteristics, unless providing accommodation would impose an undue hardship or disproportionate burden. If you require accommodation to complete an application, interview, pre-employment testing, or participate in the selection process, please contact us at . We also consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in line with applicable laws and regulations in each jurisdiction.

To all recruitment agencies: Coalition does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our email alias, employees, or other physical or virtual organization locations. Coalition is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

Core Skills

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Comfortable holding teams accountable while maintaining a positive culture.
  • Excellent communicator and motivator.
  • Organized and execution-focused.
  • Proactive leader who continuously looks for ways to improve team performance.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Lead daily sales meetings and coaching sessions.
  • Review sales pipelines and forecast performance.
  • Conduct call reviews and deal strategy discussions.
  • Coach representatives on objection handling and closing techniques.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on campaign performance and lead quality.
  • Improve sales messaging, workflows, and playbooks.
  • Analyze performance metrics and identify growth opportunities.
  • Support representatives in progressing and closing strategic opportunities.

In short: You lead the sales organization by developing people, improving performance, strengthening processes, and driving consistent revenue growth.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Team quota attainment.
  • Revenue growth.
  • Pipeline conversion rates.

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.


Job Description


Senior Data Platform Engineer

Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Data Platform Engineer to help build, scale, and operate our bespoke enterprise data platform, the foundational infrastructure layer that ingestion, ontology, and business application teams build on top of. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who wants deep technical ownership of platform internals rather than owning specific business data pipelines: our platform stack spans Airflow, Iceberg, Spark, Flink, Kafka, Nessie, Trino, and StarRocks, along with supporting UI components for platform users.

You will not own the business logic of individual data pipelines; those are owned by application and business teams. Instead, you will build and harden the core platform capabilities that make those pipelines possible: ingestion frameworks, data cleansing/harmonization utilities, storage and compute infrastructure, and the APIs and agentic (MCP) interfaces that let both humans and AI agents access and operate on platform data and capabilities. You'll also be expected to bring an agentic software development approach to your own work, using AI coding agents and tooling to meaningfully multiply your engineering throughput, not just as an experiment on the side.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Capability Engineering

  • Design, build, and operate core platform capabilities on top of Airflow, Spark, and Flink for batch and streaming data processing, providing reusable frameworks that application/business teams use to build their own pipelines rather than building pipelines on their behalf.
  • Own the data lakehouse layer built on Iceberg, Nessie (catalog/versioning), Trino, and StarRocks, including table format management, catalog governance, query performance, and storage lifecycle (compaction, partitioning, retention).
  • Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming infrastructure (topics, schema management, connectors) that supports both platform-internal needs and consumption by downstream teams.
  • Develop reusable ingestion, cleansing, and harmonization frameworks/libraries that application teams can adopt to bring data onto the platform in a consistent, quality-controlled way, without the platform team owning each pipeline's business logic.
  • Build and maintain UI components that give platform users (engineers, analysts, business teams) visibility into platform state, data catalogs, job status, and data quality.

API & Agentic (MCP) Enablement

  • Design and build APIs that expose platform data and capabilities (ingestion, querying, catalog metadata, job orchestration) to downstream teams and services in a well-governed, secure, and performant way.
  • Build and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers/interfaces that expose platform data, catalogs, and lineage to AI agents and LLM-based tools, enabling agentic consumption of platform capabilities.
  • Extend agentic enablement beyond data access by building the tooling and guardrails that allow AI agents to safely operate parts of the platform itself (e.g., triggering pipeline runs, querying job status, remediation actions), with appropriate human-in-the-loop controls where needed.
  • Partner with platform consumers (including the Ontology Platform team) to understand their API/agentic access needs and translate them into platform capability requirements.

Scalability & Resilience

  • Ensure the platform scales reliably as data volume, source count, and consumer count grow, through capacity planning, performance tuning, and architectural evolution across the stack.
  • Design for resilience: fault tolerance, disaster recovery, data consistency guarantees, and graceful degradation across ingestion, storage, and compute layers.
  • Build and maintain observability (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting) across the platform stack to detect and diagnose issues before they impact downstream teams.
  • Drive on-call/production support practices for the platform, including runbooks and incident response processes.

Engineering Practice & Productivity

  • Adopt and champion an agentic SDLC approach, using AI coding agents and related tooling as a core part of your own development workflow to substantially multiply engineering throughput (targeting materially higher output than traditional development approaches, not incremental gains).
  • Establish and evolve engineering best practices for the platform team: testing strategy, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and code/architecture review standards suited to a bespoke, multi-technology data platform.
  • Mentor other engineers on platform internals and on effective use of agentic development tooling, even without formal management responsibility.

Required Qualifications

  • 8-12 years of software/data engineering experience, with significant hands-on experience building or operating large-scale data platform infrastructure (not primarily building individual application-level data pipelines).
  • Deep, hands-on experience with at least several of: Apache Airflow, Apache Iceberg, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Nessie, Trino, StarRocks, with the ability to reason confidently about the rest and ramp up quickly where needed.
  • Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture: table formats, catalog management, query engines, and the trade-offs between batch and streaming processing.
  • Experience designing and building APIs for platform capabilities, with an understanding of API governance, versioning, and security for multi-tenant platform consumers.
  • Direct experience with, or strong interest and rapid aptitude for, building MCP servers or similar agent-facing interfaces that expose data/capabilities to AI agents and LLM-based tooling.
  • Practical, hands-on experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as a core part of your development workflow, with a track record of using them to meaningfully increase delivery speed and quality, not just occasional use.
  • Strong systems engineering fundamentals: distributed systems, performance tuning, capacity planning, and building for fault tolerance and resilience at scale.
  • Experience building and maintaining production observability (metrics, logging, tracing) for complex, multi-service data infrastructure.
  • Comfortable operating as an individual contributor with deep technical ownership, while also being able to mentor others and influence engineering practice without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or "paved road" tooling that other engineering teams adopt as self-service infrastructure.
  • Experience building agent-facing tooling or infrastructure beyond MCP (e.g., tool-use frameworks, agent orchestration, guardrails for autonomous agent actions).
  • Familiarity with UI/front-end development sufficient to build or contribute to platform-facing dashboards and tooling (not a primary requirement, but a plus).
  • Experience in financial services or another regulated, data-intensive industry, given the auditability and data-quality expectations typical of the domain.
  • Contributions to open-source projects in the Airflow/Iceberg/Spark/Flink/Trino ecosystem.

About Vasion

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

About the role

This role contributes directly to Vasion’s next chapter of growth. The Growth Marketing Manager will execute Vasion’s full-funnel demand generation and account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns across the Americas region, from campaign build through reporting, turning engagement into the pipeline that fuels the company’s growth. This is a hands-on marketing role for someone who enjoys building compelling, multi-channel campaigns, managing the details with precision, and using data to sharpen what’s working. The role partners with Paid Media, Content, Design, Product Marketing, and Web to build the campaign assets that convert prospects into pipeline.

As a Growth Marketing Manager, you'll play a critical role on our marketing team and will be responsible for planning & executing full-funnel prospect-focused campaigns and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives in the AMER region. You will execute using multiple marketing channels and work closely with our internal Sales and cross-functional marketing teams to ensure campaign alignment to drive measurable business results.

The ideal candidate will be strongly motivated by engaging and original marketing that grabs attention and starts conversations, robust project management, and using metrics and data to drive decisions.

What you'll do

Campaign Activation & ABM Execution

  • Plan, build, and manage full-funnel campaigns across email, advertising, retargeting, third-party programs, events, webinars, and social media to meet monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue and upsell targets.
  • Execute ABM initiatives and full-funnel prospect campaigns across the AMER region.
  • Orchestrate campaign execution end-to-end, from kickoff through launch and reporting, anticipating needs, resolving blockers, and keeping details from falling through the cracks.

Data & Performance

  • Optimize campaigns through A/B testing, audience segmentation, and performance analysis to improve effectiveness and ROI.
  • Analyze campaign performance data to surface insights and build clear, data-driven reports and recommendations for stakeholders.

Cross-Functional & Sales Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Sales and BDR teams to align campaign execution, optimize lead handoff, and accelerate pipeline.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Content, Design, and Web to create landing pages, emails, ads, and other materials that resonate with target audiences and drive conversion.
  • Provide regular, clear campaign updates and performance reporting to stakeholders.
Qualifications

Campaign Activation & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, including 2+ years in demand generation, integrated, or ABM campaigns.
  • Experience in SaaS, B2B, technology, or a similar industry.
  • Working knowledge of demand generation, ABM, and modern digital marketing practices, including lead nurturing, lead scoring, and marketing operations.

Communication & Data Fluency

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized, with strong project management and prioritization skills; able to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously without dropping details.
  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Skilled in analyzing performance data and using marketing analytics tools.
Benefits
  • Flexible work environment
  • Vacation Bonus
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Competitive pay
  • A full suite of traditional benefits
  • Training/Advancement opportunities
  • 401k with company match and immediate vesting
  • Financial wellness education
  • Company-contributed HSA
  • On-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc.
Our Core Values

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

  • Disruptive Visionaries: Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers.
  • Relationship Builders: We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication.
  • Candor Seekers: Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly.
  • Action Owners: Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance.
More about Vasion

About This Role

Location: Remote

Commitment: Part-time volunteer, pro bono (unpaid) role

Contribution Requirements: Minimum 10–15 hours per week; minimum 3-month commitment

Professional Volunteering

Professional volunteering is skills-based service performed with the same reliability, accountability, and quality expected in a paid professional role. Volunteers are core contributors whose work directly supports our mission of global compassion, collaboration, and action. Expectations include consistent weekly availability, timely communication, ownership and follow-through on assigned work, participation in team meetings, and alignment with our values and processes.

About Solution Community

Solution Community is an international 501(c)(3) nonprofit pioneering a social platform built to turn compassion into action. With volunteers from over 80 countries and experience drawn from companies like Apple, Google, Meta, Netflix, and Microsoft, we connect nonprofits, businesses, philanthropists, and volunteers to solve real social problems.

Our Mission

To foster a global community of compassion, uniting individuals and organizations to solve the world's social problems.

Our Vision

A world where every person has the opportunity to thrive — united by collaboration, compassion, and action.

Summary of Role

As Head of Sales, you will build and lead Solution Community's earned-revenue engine. This is not a donor-fundraising role — you will create sustainable, fee-for-service income for the organization. Your primary mandate is to launch and scale our advisory offering, which connects businesses and nonprofits with our vetted network of expert volunteers, and to develop paid partnerships that fund our mission. You will own the strategy, build the pipeline, close the first deals yourself, and lead a team of five Senior Sales Managers as the function grows.

What Will You Do?

  • Own and execute Solution Community's earned-revenue strategy — advisory/consulting engagements, paid B2B partnerships, and sponsorship packages that deliver real value to the buyer.

  • Stand up our consulting network from zero: define the offer, pricing, and revenue-share model that pays the expert volunteer and funds the organization.

  • Build a repeatable outbound sales motion — cold outreach, discovery, proposal, and close — using lean, low-cost tools.

  • Recruit, lead, and mentor a team of five Senior Sales Managers; set targets, run the pipeline, and hold the team to measurable revenue outcomes.

  • Build and manage relationships with businesses, nonprofits, and partners who buy or fund our services.

  • Track pipeline, conversion, and booked revenue; report results and forecasts to leadership.

  • Partner with Legal and Finance to keep earned-revenue activity compliant with our nonprofit status.

Who Are We Looking For?

  • 8–10+ years in sales, business development, or partnerships, with a proven record of closing revenue and hitting targets.

  • Experience building a sales function or offering from scratch — not just running an existing playbook.

  • Strong at outbound: comfortable owning cold pipeline, not waiting on inbound or warm networks.

  • Skilled at leading and coaching a distributed team.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and deal-closing skills.

  • Comfortable operating lean — no big tooling budget, high resourcefulness.

  • Committed to our mission, reliable, and accountable.

What We Offer

  • Global collaboration with leaders and strategists from top global companies.

  • Meaningful impact on global causes and communities.

  • A vibrant, multicultural team spanning 80+ countries.

  • A supportive environment rooted in compassion, integrity, innovation, and collaboration.

  • Flexible work-life with full autonomy.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth.

  • A formal recommendation upon successful completion of your volunteer term.

raw.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.
Learn more:

About the Role

Most people see a marketplace of over 60,000 training courses. We build something bigger: the chance for companies across the world to upgrade the skills of every employee they have. Global 2000 companies across the region rely on our training programs to build their most productive and admired workforces, and we back that trust with strategic partnerships.

The Curation Team turns a broad, global learning marketplace into focused, effective learning experiences for EMEA customers, prospects, and publishers. As a Curation Specialist, you will pair strong marketplace knowledge with a consultative approach to recommend the right content, build curated programs, and help EMEA customers make progress toward their workforce development goals — while accounting for the region's language diversity, local compliance needs (including GDPR), and varied working cultures.

What You Will Do

  • Translate the learning goals of EMEA customers and prospects into high-quality course mappings, curated lists, learning paths, and other recommendations that make the OpenSesame marketplace easy to use.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the EMEA Sales and Customer Success teams, and bring marketplace expertise to customer conversations, pre-sales calls, RFPs, and presentations across the region.
  • Create reusable programs, resources, documentation, and best practices that let OpenSesame deliver curation value consistently across EMEA markets and at scale.
  • Share marketplace and learning-industry insights relevant to EMEA with internal teams, and contribute to customer-facing resources, webinars, or other thought-leadership efforts.
  • Manage a portfolio of EMEA publisher relationships: act as the primary point of contact, coordinate internal support, share constructive feedback, and identify opportunities to strengthen the publisher offering in the region.
  • Surface content gaps, quality issues, and opportunities that improve how EMEA customers discover and use learning content — including content localized for the region's languages and regulatory requirements.
  • Keep requests, project details, and stakeholder communication organized and current in the team's operating systems. Deliver clear updates and dependable follow-through in a fast-moving environment, across time zones spanning the EMEA region.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives aligned to team and company priorities, including improvements to curation processes, product experiences, and go-to-market enablement for EMEA.
  • Overlap your working hours with core EMEA business hours to stay accessible to regional customers, publishers, and colleagues.
  • Travel as needed for department and full-team events, both within EMEA and, occasionally, to global company gatherings — typically less than 10% of your time.

Performance Objectives

Within 30 Days

  • Build a comprehensive understanding of the OpenSesame curation process and tools.
  • Identify the needs of EMEA customers and see where curation fits into their journey.

Within 60 Days

  • Establish yourself as the internal and external expert on OpenSesame's course offering for the EMEA region.
  • Perform course mappings for EMEA customers regularly and navigate the OpenSesame catalog skillfully on a daily basis.
  • Establish relationships with at least 5 publishers serving the region.

Within 90 Days

  • Complete curation projects on behalf of 50 unique EMEA customers, and establish relationships with at least 15 publishers serving the region.
  • Curate elearning course curricula confidently to support the launch and expansion of customer training initiatives across EMEA markets.

Within 120 Days

  • Complete curation requests consistently.
  • Serve as each publisher's primary point of contact within OpenSesame, and coordinate internal efforts to support and maintain strong, ongoing publisher relationships across the region.

Within 1 year

  • Build strong relationships with 10 or more EMEA publishers, and earn consistently positive feedback from customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Support EMEA customers at every stage of the course curation process, and create actionable project plans based on their unique business skills training goals.

Within 18 months

  • Become the go-to resource on the team for questions related to OpenSesame's business skills catalog in EMEA. Think strategically about curation, and identify opportunities to develop programs that help EMEA customers curate at scale.
  • Earn trust as an expert for both internal and external stakeholders across the region.

Within 2 years

  • Earn promotion to Senior Curation Specialist, EMEA, after building a reputation of excellence with regional publishers, customers, and OpenSesame teammates

You might notice we don’t list a traditional set of requirements or buzzwords here. That’s intentional. We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show your attention to detail, your drive to constantly improve, and your motivation to support your teammates.

Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

We use AI. For real. Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Location: This position can be based anywhere in the United Kingdom. We operate as a remote-first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel as necessary. All positions require up to 15 days of travel per year. This role will require travel as needed for department and full-team events, both within EMEA and, occasionally, to global company gatherings, typically less than 10% of your time.

Performance Driven: We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements, instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences.

Compensation: We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, relying on market data to determine compensation and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience. At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

We Care About Your Security: We’ve been made aware of a phishing scam involving individuals impersonating OpenSesame recruiters. All legitimate communication from our team will come from @opensesame.com email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message, please contact us directly at . Your security matters to us, thank you for staying vigilant.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About The Role

As a Technical Support Team Lead, you build the automation and AI layer that keeps our support organization fast, reliable, and scalable, and you lead the small team that runs on top of it.

We are building an AI-first support function, and you will design and ship the agents, workflows, and tools that embed AI into everyday support work.

What You'll Do

Automation & AI Tooling: Build and maintain automations and AI agents (with tools like Claude Code, n8n, Make, and our MCP setup) that remove manual support work, from ticket triage and reply drafting to knowledge-base upkeep and quality checks. Measure the time they save.

Process Building: Write playbooks and documentation, spot recurring issues, and fix root causes instead of repeating fixes.

Advanced Troubleshooting: Investigate complex data pipeline issues (API → SQL → platform) and coach the team to do the same.

Team Leadership: Lead a small team of Analysts: set priorities, own escalations, keep SLAs on track, and run post-mortems. Light-touch mentoring, not micromanagement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success on structured bug feedback and support tooling.

Continuous Tech Exploration: Test new AI models, agent frameworks, and tools, and bring the ones that work into production.

What You Bring

AI Builder: A power user of LLMs, coding agents (e.g. Claude Code), and automation platforms (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier) who has built a workflow, agent, or tool that is actually used. You understand prompting vs. orchestrating and can spot and fix wrong AI output.

Database Proficiency: Strong SQL and relational databases: complex queries, debugging slow scripts, finding root causes in complex schemas.

Radical Ownership: You bring order to chaos, never lose track of open issues, and prefer prevention over reaction.

Leadership & Independence: Experience coordinating teammates and staying calm under pressure. Formal management is a plus, not a prerequisite.

Tech Enthusiast: You follow new tools and experiment for fun.

raw.description:
The Transition Management Lead is a six-month contract role combining SAP SuccessFactors Learning subject-matter expertise with implementation execution, coordination, and project-management discipline.

This individual must be able to work directly with LMS administrators, business owners, and other stakeholders to translate approved learning requirements into configuration plans, identify technical and operational dependencies, review configured behavior, support testing, and resolve implementation issues. Where access, authority, and the agreed responsibility model permit, the lead may perform or directly support SuccessFactors Learning administrative and configuration activities. The role also provides structure to MSX’s workstream participation through plans, action and decision logs, status reporting, escalation, and readiness tracking.

Key Responsibilities

SuccessFactors Learning expertise and implementation support (40%)

  • Serve as MSX’s hands-on SuccessFactors Learning resource during implementation, with particular attention to learner experience, administrative workflows, catalogs, curricula, assignment profiles, learning history, certifications, assessments, and instructor-led training.
  • Review approved business requirements and configuration designs with the responsible business and technical owners; identify gaps, dependencies, and decisions needed before build or testing.
  • Coordinate platform configuration activities.
  • Perform or support other configuration tasks, including learning items, curricula, certification paths, assignment profiles, assessments, notifications, learning workflows, user roles, permissions, and administrative access controls.
  • Work with stakeholders and business owners to troubleshoot configuration issues and confirm intended learning scenarios function as approved.
  • Document configuration decisions, operating procedures, and unresolved issues for the designated long-term owners.

Transition planning and workstream coordination (25%)

  • Maintain a clear plan for MSX deliverables, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and readiness activities within the broader project plan.
  • Help define practical handoffs and responsibility boundaries among MSX, stakeholders, and business owners, escalating gaps rather than assuming unassigned accountability.
  • Facilitate MSX participation in relevant implementation and operational workstreams and provide concise status, risk, issue, and decision reporting.
  • Track dependencies involving source data, user attributes, learning rules, platform access, interfaces, reporting, and operational support.

Testing, migration validation, and launch readiness (20%)

  • Support UAT planning and execution for learner journeys, assignment logic, certifications, assessments, ILT, administrative permissions, and support scenarios.
  • Help investigate defects, document expected versus actual behavior, coordinate retesting, and track resolution with the responsible owners.
  • Support migration and reconciliation activities by helping define test scenarios, reviewing representative learner records, and coordinating exceptions. Do not assume ownership of source extraction, platform migration, ODS processing, or final business sign-off unless expressly assigned.
  • Contribute to cutover planning, launch-readiness reviews, and hypercare preparation.

Stakeholder communication and documentation (10%)

  • Translate SuccessFactors Learning concepts and implementation issues into clear, actionable guidance for project leaders, business owners, administrators, and support teams.
  • Maintain assigned process documentation, configuration notes, decisions, and handoff materials in the approved project repository.
  • Coordinate with the owners of reporting, QRGs, learner communications, and support documentation to ensure materials reflect tested system behavior.

Operational handoff (5%)

  • Transfer practical platform knowledge, troubleshooting procedures, known issues, and administrative guidance to the long-term LMS Administrator and other designated support owners.
  • Help confirm that escalation routes, access, documentation, and support procedures are ready for steady-state operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience administering or implementing SAP SuccessFactors Learning.
  • Experience with learning-platform configuration and administration, including several of the following: learner records, assignment profiles, catalogs, curricula, certifications, assessments, ILT, permissions, or reporting.
  • Experience coordinating a cross-functional technology implementation or platform transition, including plans, dependencies, risks, issues, testing, and stakeholder decisions.
  • Ability to distinguish configuration execution from business-rule approval, technical-system ownership, and project governance.
  • Strong documentation, troubleshooting, facilitation, and executive-status communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Teams, SharePoint, and project or issue-tracking tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating learning operations or records between LMS platforms, including validation and reconciliation.
  • Experience supporting a SuccessFactors Learning launch involving multiple learner populations or brands.
  • Familiarity with Cypher Learning, enterprise integrations, SSO, or downstream learning-data reporting.
  • PMP or comparable project-management training or certification.
  • Experience developing an LMS support model and transferring implementation knowledge to a steady-state team.

MSX International is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer committed to employing a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

MSX has been a trusted partner to leading vehicle manufacturers, their retailers, and mobility organizations globally for more than 30 years. Our unwavering commitment is to help our clients transform their businesses and effectively manage operations in the areas of: Sales Performance; Repair Optimization and Compliance; Parts and Accessories Sales Performance; and Consumer Engagement. With our global teams, industry expertise, and the power of technology, we design and deliver tailored, sustainable, and innovative solutions and services that help our clients optimize their operations and captivate their customers.

raw.excerpt: About Revolution Prep Revolution Prep is a high-growth, performance-driven company committed to transforming education while remaining true to our social mission.
raw.description:
About Revolution Prep

Revolution Prep is a high-growth, performance-driven company committed to transforming education while remaining true to our social mission.

Our people define the Revolution. Revolutionaries are talented, resourceful, and tenacious. To be a “Revolutionary” means to come to work ready to collaborate, achieve, and to inspire. As a result, passion and energy feed into a collegial, entrepreneurial, and fast-paced culture that permeates throughout our workspace.

Full-Time Professional Online Tutor – SAT/ACT Math

Remote | Full-Time W-2 | $25/hr Starting Pay | Paid Training & Prep | Benefits

Make a Difference. Build a Career. Tutor from Home.

Make a meaningful impact on students’ academic journeys—all from the comfort of your home. Join Revolution Prep as a full-time tutor and enjoy the stability, benefits, and support of being a full-time W-2 employee—not an independent contractor.

We provide a dynamic, in-house curriculum and a wealth of teaching resources, so you can spend less time creating lesson plans and searching for materials and more time doing what you do best: helping students learn and succeed.

You’ll also receive paid training and prep time, along with a supportive community of fellow tutors who are passionate about education. Whether you’re helping a student master a challenging concept, build confidence, or reach an important academic goal, your work makes a real difference.

Schedule Requirements

This role requires a consistent weekly schedule and a minimum of 38 hours of availability, including evenings and weekends.

  • The goal is 30+ hours of tutoring per week, though actual hours may vary based on student demand and your subject expertise.
  • At least 8 hours of weekend availability required
  • Availability must remain consistent from week to week
  • Schedules are posted in 2-6 hour blocks and extend 9+ months into the future
  • Time-off requests should generally be submitted at least 4 weeks in advance
  • Minimum one-year employment commitment

Prime-time availability:

  • Monday–Thursday: 3–11 PM ET
  • Friday: 3–7 PM ET
  • Saturday: 9 AM–7 PM ET
  • Sunday: 9 AM–10 PM ET

What You'll Teach

  • SAT and ACT Math test preparation
  • High-school mathematics through Algebra II
  • Executive function skills such as organization, planning, time management and study strategies
  • Additional subjects based on your expertise and Revolution Prep's needs

What You'll Do

  • Lead engaging online tutoring sessions using Revolution Prep's curriculum and resources
  • Help students understand challenging concepts and develop effective learning strategies
  • Prepare for sessions using company-provided materials
  • Communicate with students and families about academic progress
  • Build supportive relationships that motivate students to reach their goals
  • Participate in paid training and ongoing professional development
  • Collaborate with Faculty Leaders and fellow tutors to continuously improve your teaching

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • At least 1 year of professional teaching or tutoring experience
  • Comfortable teaching math through Algebra II
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to explain challenging concepts clearly and patiently
  • SAT/ACT tutoring or test-preparation experience is a plus
  • AP STEM subject expertise is a plus
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Authorized to work in the U.S. and currently residing in the U.S.

Why Join Revolution Prep?

  • Full-time W-2 employment
  • $25/hour starting rate for tutoring
  • Opportunity to earn up to $29/hour after the 90-day review, based on performance and subject coverage
  • Paid prep and training time
  • Health insurance
  • 401(k) options
  • Bonus opportunities
  • Paid onboarding and ongoing professional development
  • Proven curriculum and subject-specific materials provided
  • No need to compete for tutoring hours; hours are allocated based on availability and subject expertise
  • Support from experienced Faculty Leaders
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on students' academic and personal development

Technology Requirements

You'll need:

  • A Mac or PC desktop/laptop
  • Reliable high-speed internet with an Ethernet connection
  • At least 4GB available RAM
  • A quiet, professional workspace suitable for online instruction

Revolution Prep can provide a technology kit for tutors who need one, including a webcam, headset, ring light, green screen and annotation tablet.

Our Hiring Process

After submitting your application, candidates will receive a link to a required approximately 30-minute assessment. The assessment helps Revolution Prep evaluate subject knowledge and overall fit for the Professional Tutor role.

Candidates who advance in the process will also complete a comprehensive background check.

Q&A

Q: Are there additional responsibilities?

A: In addition to tutoring, you'll communicate with families about student progress and prepare for sessions using company-provided materials. Both collectively make up around 10% of your workload and are paid time. We also offer ongoing professional development which is paid.

Q: How flexible is the time-off policy?

A: Requests for time off must be submitted at least 4 weeks in advance. We understand emergencies happen, so we have systems in place for coverage in those events.

Q: Is ongoing training part of the role?

A: Yes, ongoing professional development is required – we offer 24 hours of paid training per year after the initial onboarding.

Connect With Us

Company Website, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube

Revolution Prep is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender, genetic information, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other status or classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

This employer participates in E-Verify.

raw.title: Director of Analytics - Remote
raw.excerpt: Employee Benefits is the core of our business and at our heart we are a people-focused organization.
raw.description:
Employee Benefits is the core of our business and at our heart we are a people-focused organization. Every day, we help over 100,000 employers give their employees peace of mind by providing health, pharmacy, long and short-term disability, vision, dental and other insurance solutions. What makes us unique is that we can surround our clients with more services and more technology-based tools and a team of advisors that simply cares more than anyone else.

If you want a career giving people the reassurance that they can have access to the health care they need for themselves and their loved ones, join OneDigital.

Our Newest Opportunity:

Director of Analytics — Enterprise Solutions

OneDigital is seeking a technically hands-on Director of Analytics to lead our analytics and data science function and to serve as product owner for OneDigital's proprietary AI-driven, web-based analytics platform.


This is a builder-leader role with an enterprise mandate. You will own the platform's vision and roadmap, partner with regional and business-line stakeholders to decide which models and solutions get built, lead a team of four data scientists who build them, and set the broader data and analytics strategy. The platform's initial depth is in employee benefits, and you will be responsible for extending it across other OneDigital lines of business over time — building solutions and a data foundation designed to scale beyond any single practice.


The ideal candidate comes from a healthcare brokerage or benefits consulting background and already speaks the language of the work — underwriting, IBNR, plan design modeling, contribution strategy, and financial projections. Equally important, you are technical and innovative: you understand the full lifecycle of building and shipping a web application, and you have used AI to turn spreadsheet-bound underwriting processes into scalable products. An ASA or FSA designation is not required.


Responsibilities

  • Own the platform as a product — set the vision, define and maintain the roadmap, prioritize the backlog, and be accountable for adoption and business impact.
  • Engage regional leaders, consultants, and business-line stakeholders to surface pain points in how they underwrite, model, and report, and translate those into prioritized models and solutions.
  • Own the full delivery lifecycle of those tools: discovery, design, build, validation, release, user enablement, and iteration based on real usage.
  • Serve as the enterprise subject matter expert on benefits financial methodology — medical and Rx underwriting, IBNR and reserve analysis, trend development, large claimant analysis, plan design modeling and repricing, contribution modeling, multi-year projections, stop-loss evaluation, and renewal support — ensuring the methods embedded in the platform are accurate and defensible.
  • Extend the platform's reach beyond employee benefits, identifying where analytics and AI-enabled tooling can create similar value in other lines of business.
  • Act as a go-to resource for regional teams on complex client financial questions, including self-funding feasibility, funding strategy, and cost containment, building their capability rather than absorbing the work.
  • Use AI and generative AI, including coding assistants and LLM platforms such as Claude, to accelerate development and embed intelligence into analytics products.
  • Bring forward-thinking ideas and drive continuous improvement — scanning for emerging technologies and methods, and pressure-testing them through rapid prototyping.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of four data scientists (two senior, two junior), raising technical standards and building a culture of experimentation and rapid delivery.
  • Define and execute the enterprise data and analytics strategy, including how data is aggregated, structured, governed, and leveraged across business lines.
  • Partner with actuarial, brokerage, consulting, IT, and executive leadership to connect analytics investments to measurable business and client outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience in employee benefits financial analytics, underwriting, or actuarial analysis within a healthcare brokerage, benefits consulting firm, carrier, or TPA. Brokerage or consulting experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated command of core benefits financial tools: underwriting, IBNR analysis, trend development, plan design modeling, contribution modeling, and financial projections.
  • Strong understanding of the employee benefits ecosystem and how brokers, carriers, employers, TPAs, and PBMs interact, with the curiosity to learn adjacent lines of business.
  • Experience owning a product, platform, or internal tool end to end — setting direction, prioritizing competing stakeholder needs, and shipping on a roadmap.
  • Working knowledge of the full web application development lifecycle. You need not be an engineering manager, but should hold a credible technical conversation about architecture, releases, and tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on technical skill building analytical tools, not just directing others who build them. Comfort with SQL and Python or R, and experience delivering web-based applications rather than spreadsheets alone.
  • Practical experience using AI and generative AI to build products, models, or automations, with a clear view of where they add value and where they don't.
  • Experience leading and developing data scientists, analysts, or other technical professionals.
  • Proven ability to build trust with regional or field teams and become the person they bring hard problems to.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical, consulting, executive, and client-facing audiences, with strong business acumen and a bias toward shipping solutions that get used.

The typical base pay range for this role nationwide is $195,000 to $220,000 per year.

Your base pay is dependent upon your skills, education, qualifications, professional experience, and location. In addition to base pay, some roles are eligible for variable compensation, commission, and/or annual bonus based on your individual performance and/or the company’s performance. We also offer eligible employees health, wellbeing, retirement, and other financial benefits, paid time off, overtime pay for non-exempt employees, and robust learning and development programs. You will receive reimbursement of job-related expenses per the company policy and may receive employee perks and discounts.

To learn more, visit: www.onedigital.com/careers

OneDigital is an equal opportunity employer. Not only as a matter of standard, but to honor and celebrate our differences. We believe that the power of ONE starts with you. We are committed to cultivating and preserving a culture that celebrates diversity, insists on equity and inclusion, and connects us. Ensuring our people feel seen, valued, respected, and supported is fundamental to our core values and business goals.

OneDigital provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment regardless of their: veteran status, uniformed servicemember status, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age (40 and over), pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics) or any other category protected by federal, state or local law (collectively, “protected characteristics”). A copy of the Federal EEO poster is linked here.

Pursuant to local Fair Chance Ordinances, we will consider qualified applications with arrest or conviction records for employment. For applicable candidates, the following ordinances are linked here to inform you of your rights as an applicant:

City and County of San Francsico

City of Los Angeles

County of Los Angeles

Employment decisions shall comply with all other applicable federal, state and city/county laws prohibiting discrimination in employment. OneDigital complies with all criminal history inquiry [or ‘ban the box’] laws in California, Connecticut, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New Mexico, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont and Washington.

In short, we believe in hiring the most qualified applicant for the position, regardless of background.

If you have questions about our hiring policies and practices, we would be happy to discuss upon receiving your application. We hope to welcome you to OneDigital and look forward to hearing from you.

OneDigital understands the immense responsibility and opportunities provided by Artificial Intelligence. We utilize advanced Artificial Intelligence [AI] technologies to enhance our recruitment process. This includes using AI to filter candidates based on their qualifications and to rediscover potential candidates from our existing applicant pool. Our AI systems help us efficiently identify the best fit for our open positions, ensuring a streamlined and effective hiring experience. However, AI does not replace the humans in our process. If you have concerns about our use of AI, you may opt out where laws allow.

Thank you for your interest in joining the OneDigital team!

description: PLAYERSBEST is an online lead generation company that creates quality leads in highly competitive verticals, such as iGaming, Financials, Health and Communications.

raw.title: Senior Data Engineer
raw.excerpt: PLAYERSBEST is an online lead generation company that creates quality leads in highly competitive verticals, such as iGaming, Financials, Health and Communications.
raw.description:
PLAYERSBEST is an online lead generation company that creates quality leads in highly competitive verticals, such as iGaming, Financials, Health and Communications. We focus on building high-end websites with quality content that let customers make an informed decision about the product they’re about to buy or sign-up to. We pride ourselves on adopting a customer-focused approach to quality and usability.

About the role

We are expanding our Data & BI team and looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to own the data model and the medallion framework (Bronze, Silver, Gold) that turn raw data into trusted, business-ready numbers. Our platform runs on Google Cloud, with dbt on BigQuery, Airflow and ClickHouse.

What you'll do

  • Design and own the medallion framework: Bronze for raw landing, Silver for cleaned and conformed data, Gold for business-ready marts
  • Design the core dimensional model of facts and dimensions (traffic, clicks, registrations, deposits, commissions, costs), with clear grain and conformed keys
  • Build these layers as tested, documented transformation models with agreed business definitions
  • Write and maintain Airflow DAGs, and use ClickHouse for high-volume event data
  • Add data quality checks and alerts, help integrate new sources, and take part in architecture discussions and code reviews

What we're looking for

  • At least 4 years' working experience as a Data Engineer or Data Warehouse developer
  • Working experience in the iGaming or affiliate marketing industry
  • Excellent, confident SQL: complex joins, window functions and tuning queries on large datasets
  • Very good, production-level Python for pipelines, API integrations and automation
  • Hands-on experience with dbt, Airflow and BigQuery (or Snowflake, Redshift), with ClickHouse as a plus
  • Strong data modelling skills: star schemas, fact grain, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions and surrogate keys
  • Proven experience designing and building a layered (medallion) architecture in production
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD
  • Uses AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code or Copilot) to speed up development, and reviews what they produce
  • Very good communication skills in English (mandatory)
  • Experience with Spark/PySpark, Databricks, Delta Lake, AWS (S3, AppFlow, Step Functions), ClickHouse or Terraform (nice to have).

What we offer

  • Collaborative Environment: Work closely with engineering, product, and marketing teams in a dynamic, data-driven culture that values your expertise
  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and other benefits
  • Flexible & Remote-Friendly: Work remotely, on-site, or hybrid, with the flexibility to suit your lifestyle

raw.title: Enterprise Account Executive- TN/KY
raw.excerpt: About Glean:Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI.
raw.description:
About Glean:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

Glean is seeking an Enterprise Account Executive for a high-impact sales role focused on driving new business and expanding relationships within large enterprise accounts. AEs at Glean are responsible for landing and managing multi-million dollar, often global, accounts by leveraging Glean’s differentiated AI technology and foundational knowledge graph to deliver tangible business outcomes for customers.

You will:

  • Source and close net new logos within a given territory
  • Have the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and identify executive sponsors and champions
  • Research and understand the business objectives of your customers and have the ability to perform a value drive sales cycle
  • Collaborate with internal partners to move deals forward and ensure customer success
  • You will consistently deliver ARR revenue targets and drive success through a metric based approach
  • Develop and execute sales strategies and tactics to generate pipeline, drive sales opportunities and deliver repeatable and predictable bookings
  • Provide timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions
  • Create ROI and business justification reports based off of a data driven approach
  • Run tight POCs based off of business success criteria

About you:

  • 6+ years of closing experience in Sales with a track record of being a top performer
  • Ability to learn, pitch and demonstrate a highly technical product and have the ability to adapt in a fast growing and changing environment
  • Have clear examples of closing complex deals and selling into complex organizations
  • Effectively use a repeatable method for uncovering greenfield opportunities and building out a new territory
  • Previous experience building relationships and selling face to face to C level executives
  • Knowledge of best of breed softwares and a technical understanding of integrations, APIs, infrastructure management, security and analytics
  • Experience selling technical SaaS and cloud based software solutions
  • Basic understanding of search infrastructure is a plus
  • You have previous experience working with multiple teammates including SEs, BDRs, PMs, Executives & Engineers
  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and using MEDDIC and Challenger (or similar) methodologies is a plus.
Location:
  • This role is remote (must be located in Ohio Valley: Ohio, Michigan, Tennessee, Kentucky, Kansas, Missouri, or Indiana)

Compensation & Benefits:

The OTE range for this role is $280,000 - $300,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.
We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

AI-First Mindset at Glean:

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.
Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:
Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement.

By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

raw.excerpt: CareerSwift is a technology company focused on making the job search process simpler, faster, and more effective.
raw.description:
CareerSwift is a technology company focused on making the job search process simpler, faster, and more effective. Our platform combines AI-powered tools and practical career solutions to help job seekers create stronger applications, improve their professional profiles, and navigate their job search with greater confidence.

We are growing our team and are looking for a friendly, reliable, and customer-focused Call Centre Agent, Inbound to join our remote team.

As a Call Centre Agent, Inbound, you will be one of the first points of contact for CareerSwift customers and users. You will handle incoming calls, answer questions, provide information about our products and services, and help customers resolve common issues.

This role is focused on delivering a positive customer experience rather than cold calling or aggressive sales. You will also work with internal teams when a customer request requires additional assistance.

Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming customer calls in a friendly and professional manner.

  • Understand customer questions and provide accurate information and assistance.

  • Help customers resolve common issues and guide them through basic processes.

  • Escalate complex or technical issues to the appropriate team.

  • Accurately document customer interactions and resolutions in internal systems.

  • Follow up on open customer requests when required.

  • Share recurring customer questions or issues with the relevant internal teams.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.

  • Friendly, patient, and customer-focused approach.

  • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally over the phone.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Comfortable working with computers and online systems.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple customer requests.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in a call centre, customer service, help desk, or similar role.

  • Experience using CRM or customer support platforms.

  • Experience working remotely or supporting customers online.

  • Interest in technology, AI-powered products, or career development.

Compensation

$36,000 - $45,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

Additional benefits and employment details will be discussed during the hiring process.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.

  • Training and support to help you succeed.

  • Experience working with modern digital and AI-powered products.

  • Collaborative team environment.

  • Opportunities for professional growth as CareerSwift expands.

Apply today and join CareerSwift in helping people navigate their job search with smarter technology and better support.

Location: Remote

Salary Range: 36,000 - 45,000 USD (gross, annually)

Job Description:

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at


On October 14, 2025, Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.


It is anticipated following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes, and your employment would be governed by Orthopaedics employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. Details of any planned changes would be provided to you by Orthopaedics at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

We are searching for the best talent for Lead Analyst, Commercial Data & AI.

The Lead Analyst, Commercial Data & AI supports the end-to-end analytical and AI enablement workstream for the Depuy Synthes global Commercial systems and operations to enable consistent data insights and user engagement. This role builds trusted datasets and KPI frameworks and delivers predictive and generative AI solutions that improve lead generation, opportunity management, customer engagement, and commercial execution. The Lead Analyst partners closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, and Data Strategies to ensure data quality, measurement integrity, and responsible AI practices.

Responsibilities

  • Build and govern customer data assets: Partner with Data Strategies to define source-of-truth datasets, data definitions, and quality monitoring; document logic and ensure reproducibility.
  • Data Quality & integrity: Monitor and improve data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across systems.
  • GenAI for Commercial enablement: Prototype and evaluate generative AI use cases (e.g., message variant generation, subject line testing, content summarization, agent-assist) with clear guardrails, human validation layer, and measurement.
  • Stakeholder leadership: Partner on analytics intake and prioritization for CRM and other Commercial platforms; translate ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses, analytical plans, and deliverables.
  • Commercial measurement and insights: Define and standardize KPI frameworks, translate business needs into clean, usable data models, and communicate data structure insights to leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Responsible data & AI: Ensure compliance with data privacy, consent, security, and AI governance policies; identify bias/fairness risks and propose mitigations.
  • Mentorship: Coach analysts on analytical rigor, SQL best practices, and experimentation while ensuring data quality, governance, and reproducibility.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or marketing/customer analytics, including hands-on CRM/lifecycle measurement.
  • Advanced SQL skills (complex joins, window functions, CTEs) and experience working with large-scale, complex datasets.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Alteryx Designer to build, automate, and optimize end-to-end data workflows.
  • Strong ability to clean, blend, and transform large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
  • Strong knowledge of Orthopaedics products, procedures, and customer profiles.
  • Experience translating business questions into hypotheses, analytical approaches, and clear recommendations on optimal data structure to meet stakeholder needs.
  • Ability to partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and influence without direct authority.
  • Knowledge of data privacy concepts relevant to CRM (consent, suppression, PII handling) and comfort working within governance controls.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to create executive-ready materials.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM and Commercial platforms (e.g. Salesforce Life Science Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Movemedical, Tableau Server)
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Reltio, AWS, Snowflake, SAP, Redshift, Databricks)
  • Experience with customer identity resolution, attribution approaches, and performance concepts.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing GenAI solutions (prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation/guardrails).
  • Experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and semantic modeling.

Core Competencies

  • Systems thinking across data, process, and technology
  • Data strategy, governance, and quality management
  • Workflow automation and data engineering fluency
  • GenAI product thinking and innovation mindset
  • Advanced analytical problem solving
  • Commercial analytics acumen
  • Bias awareness and responsible AI mindset
